jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (Java / Agentic AI)
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer (Java / Agentic AI) based in Romania. The Chief Technology Officer will lead Engineering and Quality Assurance for an international aviation software business supporting safety- and time-critical flight operations. This hands-on executive role combines technical strategy, engineering leadership, and practical expertise in AI-powered software development. You will guide a team of approximately 17 professionals while building and operating a fleet of coding agents capable of planning, implementing, testing, and submitting code changes. You will also modernise a business-critical Java and PostgreSQL platform while maintaining delivery speed, reliability, and security. Working closely with Product, Operations, customers, and partners, you will shape the technology roadmap and drive continuous engineering improvement. This is an opportunity to influence the future of software engineering through agentic AI in a demanding, mission-critical environment. Accountabilities:: As CTO, you will own the technical direction, engineering operations, and quality strategy, balancing long-term platform modernisation with reliable day-to-day delivery. You will lead people, architecture, and AI-driven development initiatives while ensuring that engineering practices meet the highest standards of security, performance, and operational resilience. Lead and develop an Engineering and QA organisation of approximately 17 people, including hiring, coaching, technical mentoring, pairing, early design reviews, and direct feedback. Build and operate a hosted fleet of AI coding agents capable of planning, implementing, testing, and opening pull requests in parallel. Define standards for agent isolation, security, cost management, and observability, ensuring automated checks and engineer approval before code is merged. Benchmark coding agents against real engineering tasks and maintain shared agent skills, engineering guidelines, and automated quality checks. Modernise a business-critical Java and PostgreSQL platform while maintaining continuous product delivery. Define domain boundaries, data ownership, API contracts, and event-driven interfaces, while extending the functional core of a hexagonal architecture. Improve end-to-end platform performance and take ownership of reliability, security, incident response, and engineering compliance. Lead risk-based testing across Engineering and QA, ensuring robust quality practices and dependable releases. Maintain on-demand release capabilities with thoroughly tested rollback procedures. Partner with Product and Operations leaders to shape technical strategy, prioritise roadmap initiatives, and align engineering decisions with business objectives. Represent the Engineering organisation in discussions with customers and external partners. Continuously assess and improve engineering workflows, particularly the integration of AI agents into software development and delivery. Requirements : The ideal candidate is an experienced technology leader with a strong software engineering background, recent hands-on Java expertise, and a proven ability to integrate coding agents into production engineering workflows. You should combine architectural depth and operational discipline with the leadership skills needed to scale teams and modernise complex systems without disrupting critical services. At least 12 years of software development experience and 5 or more years in senior technical leadership roles. Recent hands-on experience developing and shipping Java applications in production. Daily use of AI coding agents as a core engineering workflow, supported by concrete examples of workflows you have built, operated, and evaluated. jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer in Test (AI-Driven Quality Engineering)
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer in Test (AI-Driven Quality Engineering) based in Romania. The Principal Software Development Engineer in Test will provide technical leadership for quality engineering across Windows desktop products and software development kits (SDKs). You will shape the test automation strategy while driving a new approach to AI-powered testing and continuous quality improvement. A key part of the role involves designing and deploying AI agents capable of transforming Jira tickets into reviewed test cases and automated tests integrated into CI pipelines. You will combine deep testing expertise with AI engineering to improve coverage, accelerate execution, and reduce repetitive manual work. Working in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment, you will define how automation and human expertise complement one another. This is an opportunity to influence engineering standards and build scalable, intelligent quality processes. Accountabilities:: You will lead the technical direction of the SDK testing team while developing the frameworks, automation architecture, and AI-driven workflows needed to strengthen product quality. You will remain hands-on in testing and engineering, ensuring that automation delivers reliable results and that human oversight is applied where it matters most. Provide technical leadership to the SDK testing team, establishing automation architecture, engineering standards, code review practices, and mentoring. Develop and improve test automation frameworks, writing clean, maintainable, and reviewable test code. Expand automated regression coverage by using AI agents to convert existing manual test cases into automated tests. Execute manual and automated test cases, identifying, documenting, tracking, and following up on defects. Monitor quality engineering performance and improve test coverage, execution speed, reliability, and overall testing efficiency. Design, build, and operate AI agents across the quality engineering lifecycle, including requirements analysis, ticket assessment, test case design, test generation, execution, and failure triage. Create multi-agent workflows that can take Jira tickets through to reviewed test cases and automated tests integrated into CI pipelines. Manage the prompts, tools, context, and skills powering AI agents, maintaining them under version control and applying sound engineering practices. Establish appropriate review and approval processes for AI-generated work, ensuring human validation for high-risk outputs while allowing greater autonomy where reliability has been demonstrated. Define evaluation frameworks and performance metrics for AI agents, including test case accuracy, false positives, test flakiness, and mean time to release. Build secure agent tooling by protecting sensitive credentials and restricting access to data according to security requirements. Determine when exploratory or manual testing is more appropriate than automation, balancing efficiency with product reliability. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines extensive software testing and automation experience with proven technical leadership and practical experience integrating AI agents into real quality engineering workflows. You should be comfortable working across desktop applications, CI/CD environments, and complex testing infrastructure, with the judgment to balance automation, security, and human oversight. At least 6 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience, including technical leadership of a team or significant initiative. At least 4 years of hands-on test automation experience, including developing automated tests and supporting frameworks for desktop applications, preferably using C#. At least 1 year of experience integrating AI agents into an operati

jobs.title: Head of Procurement
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Procurement based in United Arab Emirates. The Head of Procurement will lead and develop the procurement function within a fast-growing, globally distributed technology organisation. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will own the end-to-end procurement strategy, operating model, systems, and commercial performance of key supplier relationships. You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in major negotiations, particularly across software, SaaS, cloud, AI tools, and professional services. Working closely with Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and business leaders, you will ensure purchasing decisions are efficient, cost-effective, and compliant. You will also drive automation and AI adoption to simplify procurement processes and improve operational scalability. This is an opportunity to build an AI-first procurement function while delivering measurable savings and supporting the organisation’s continued growth. Accountabilities:: As Head of Procurement, you will establish the strategy, processes, and governance needed to manage company-wide purchasing effectively. You will lead strategic sourcing initiatives, optimise supplier relationships, and ensure procurement operations remain scalable, transparent, and aligned with business priorities. Own company-wide sourcing, contracting, and purchasing activities, defining the procurement operating model, policies, approval processes, exceptions, and service-level agreements from initial request through contract signature and purchase order. Lead negotiations for new purchases and contract renewals, particularly across software and SaaS, cloud and AI tools, and professional services, personally managing high-value and executive-level vendor discussions. Drive cost reduction and technology consolidation initiatives in partnership with IT and budget owners, establishing savings targets and tracking financial impact and return on investment. Collaborate with FP&A on annual budgeting and forecasting, maintaining renewal calendars, committed spend visibility, and multi-year cost projections. Coordinate proactive software renewal planning with IT and business stakeholders, ensuring clear ownership, defined timelines, and effective negotiation strategies. Oversee supplier governance in collaboration with Legal, Information Security, and Accounting, covering vendor risk, contractual terms, data processing agreements, supplier records, and procure-to-pay controls. Manage and continuously improve the procurement technology stack, including intake-to-purchase-order workflows, financial systems, expense management, and contract management tools. Establish and oversee operating models with external procurement partners, using automation and AI to reduce manual work and accelerate procurement cycles. Collaborate with internal automation teams to identify opportunities to leverage process automation technology and improve procurement efficiency. Lead, coach, and develop the Procurement Specialist and external procurement contractor, setting priorities, managing capacity, and planning for the function’s future growth. Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and budget owners on sourcing strategies, supplier risk, and procurement decisions. Report key procurement performance indicators to the CFO, including savings, cycle times, policy compliance, and spend under management. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings substantial procurement and strategic sourcing experience, preferably within a scaling B2B software or SaaS environment. You should be commercially minded, comfortable leading complex negotiations, and capable of building efficient procurement processes while balancing cost control, risk management, and stakeholder needs. jobs.title: Director, GSI Alliances
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, GSI Alliances based in United Arab Emirates. The Director, GSI Alliances will lead the development and execution of a strategic partnership ecosystem across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This senior leadership role focuses on building high-impact relationships with global systems integrators (GSIs) and turning them into sustainable drivers of business growth. You will define regional priorities, strengthen executive partnerships, and create joint go-to-market strategies that accelerate customer adoption. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Services, Product, and global Alliances teams, you will align partner initiatives with business objectives and customer needs. You will also develop scalable service offerings and capabilities that help organisations strengthen their cyber resilience. This is an opportunity to shape a regional strategy, build a high-performing team, and influence how enterprise customers approach data security and recovery. Accountabilities:: As Director, GSI Alliances, you will own the regional partnership strategy and ensure that relationships with strategic integrators translate into measurable commercial outcomes. You will combine executive engagement, operational leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to expand the partner ecosystem and strengthen market presence. Define and lead the regional GSI strategy, identifying priority partners, investment opportunities, and joint business objectives. Build and maintain senior-level relationships with regional and global GSI executives, developing strategic plans that generate sourced and influenced pipeline. Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, and specialist sales teams to coordinate partner engagement across strategic accounts and deliver a consistent customer experience. Develop and scale partner-led service offerings, certifications, and delivery practices focused on data security, cyber recovery, and identity resilience. Recruit, coach, and develop a high-performing GSI Alliances team, establishing clear objectives and opportunities for professional growth. Manage GSI forecasts, business plans, and quarterly business reviews, using performance data to evaluate results and identify growth opportunities. Represent the organisation at partner events, customer briefings, and industry forums, strengthening its position in regulated sectors such as financial services, public services, and healthcare. Collaborate with global Alliances and Product leadership to incorporate regional partner and customer insights into product roadmaps, programmes, and incentive strategies. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in enterprise technology partnerships, with a strong record of building successful GSI relationships and delivering measurable business results. You should combine strategic thinking and commercial discipline with the leadership skills needed to influence senior stakeholders across multiple markets and functions. Significant experience in alliances, partnerships, or channel leadership within enterprise software, ideally in cybersecurity, data protection, cloud, or infrastructure. Proven success developing senior-level relationships with global systems integrators and converting partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue. Experience managing and developing teams, as well as influencing cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Services. Strong understanding of GSI business models, including services attachment, managed services, and practice development, with the ability to build compelling joint value propositions. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute regional strategies across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments. Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive presence, with confidence engaging C-level stakeholders

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Product based in United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a hands-on product leader to take ownership of an established, revenue-generating digital marketplace connecting content creators with their audiences. In this strategic leadership role, you will define the product vision, shape the roadmap, and drive initiatives that improve customer experience and business performance. You will focus on key B2C growth metrics, including conversion, retention, and monetization, while ensuring platform stability and operational excellence. Working closely with Engineering, Growth, Commercial, BI, and other cross-functional teams, you will turn customer insights and data into impactful product decisions. You will also explore opportunities to leverage AI to enhance product performance, customer experience, and internal workflows. With significant autonomy and ownership, you will help guide the evolution of a high-volume transactional platform where payments, trust, safety, and compliance are essential. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact on an established digital product while collaborating with a diverse, international team. Accountabilities:: Define and own the product strategy, vision, priorities, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with customer needs and broader business objectives. Drive B2C growth by identifying and implementing opportunities to improve conversion rates, customer retention, monetization, and the overall experience for creators and their audiences. Establish clear success metrics, monitor product performance, and use data-driven insights to continuously optimize outcomes. Lead product delivery in close collaboration with Engineering, translating strategic priorities into clear requirements, actionable plans, and achievable milestones. Identify dependencies, address delivery blockers, and improve visibility, accountability, and predictability across product and engineering execution. Oversee platform health and prioritize critical product improvements, balancing innovation and growth with reliability, trust, safety, and regulatory compliance. Collaborate with Engineering, Commercial, Growth, BI, and other stakeholders to align priorities, challenge assumptions, resolve competing demands, and communicate strategic trade-offs to leadership. Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate AI into the product and internal workflows, working with AI and BI teams to test solutions and measure their impact. Gradually assume full ownership of day-to-day product leadership and execution, establishing a clear operating framework and measurable performance improvements within the first 90 days. Requirements: At least 7 years of experience in product management, with substantial expertise building, managing, or scaling B2C digital products. Proven experience owning an established, revenue-generating product, including product strategy, roadmap development, execution, and performance management. Demonstrated success in improving key business and product metrics, such as conversion, retention, customer satisfaction, and monetization. Strong product judgment and strategic thinking, with the ability to combine customer insights, quantitative data, and commercial considerations to make effective decisions, even with incomplete information. Experience working closely with Engineering teams on technically complex digital products, including navigating operational challenges and regulatory requirements. Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and its applications in digital products and product management, including the ability to evaluate opportunities, limitations, and potential risks. jobs.title: Engineering Team Lead - AI First
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Team Lead - AI First based in Romania. We are looking for an experienced Engineering Team Lead to lead an autonomous team of Product Engineers in an AI-first, fully remote environment. This hands-on leadership role combines technical architecture, software development, and people management, with an equal focus on building systems and developing engineering talent. You will guide a team of 4–5 engineers who take ownership of product decisions, from initial concepts through implementation and deployment, using AI agents to accelerate development. Working closely with a dedicated Product Manager, you will establish technical direction, ensure engineering quality, and empower your team to deliver independently without relying on detailed specifications. This is an opportunity to shape modern engineering practices, leverage cutting-edge AI tools, and build high-impact products while enjoying exceptional location flexibility. Accountabilities:: Lead the technical direction and professional development of an autonomous engineering team, balancing hands-on architectural contributions with people leadership. Ensure that engineers take end-to-end ownership of their work while maintaining high standards of software quality, scalability, security, and delivery. Own the technical vision and architecture for your product domain, making key decisions regarding system design, scalability, maintainability, and technical direction. Lead and mentor a team of 4–5 Product Engineers, helping them develop the skills and confidence to independently translate product goals into technical solutions. Spend approximately 50% of your time on technical leadership, including architecture design, AI agent direction, code reviews, and evaluating engineering decisions. Dedicate the remaining time to people management, including recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, career development, and salary negotiations. Coach engineers to take ownership of product decisions, identify edge cases, write their own tickets, and determine when to involve the Product Manager. Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to translate product objectives into effective technical execution while maintaining clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities. Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from system design and cloud infrastructure to deployment, maintenance, and ongoing operations. Direct and supervise AI coding agents, ensuring their output meets standards for reliability, security, performance, and maintainability. Establish engineering practices that encourage independent problem-solving, technical accountability, and continuous improvement. Foster a strong remote team culture through effective asynchronous communication, meaningful feedback, and limited but purposeful meetings. Encourage innovation and experimentation, supporting engineers in developing and validating new product ideas. Balance technical execution with team health, ensuring engineers have the guidance, autonomy, and resources needed to succeed. Requirements : The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer and people leader who combines strong technical judgment with a product-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working without detailed specifications, making independent decisions, and using AI agents as an integral part of the development process. You enjoy remaining technically involved while helping engineers grow into autonomous product owners, and you can build effective teams in distributed, asynchronous environments. At least 1–2 years of experience in engineering people management, including performance management, career development, and maintaining team health. At least 5 years of experience delivering production-ready software and making sound technical decisions across different technologies or development stacks. Stro

jobs.title: Head of Business Insights & Growth
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Business Insights & Growth based in United Arab Emirates. As Head of Business Insights & Growth, you will lead a newly established strategic function focused on transforming business data, market intelligence, and operational insights into measurable commercial results. You will build and manage a multidisciplinary team of five specialists covering business analytics, market intelligence, client growth, promotions, process optimisation, and AI adoption. Working closely with senior leadership, you will play a key role in shaping business strategy, accelerating revenue growth, improving client retention, and increasing operational efficiency. You will establish a structured, data-driven approach to identifying opportunities, turning recommendations into actionable initiatives, and scaling successful solutions across markets and business units. In a fast-paced, international, and technology-driven environment, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution. This is an exciting opportunity to influence business performance, drive innovation, and build a function with a direct impact on long-term growth. Accountabilities:: Define and lead the overall Business Insights & Growth strategy, ensuring alignment with organisational objectives and commercial priorities. Translate strategic business priorities into clear quarterly and semi-annual goals, establishing measurable outcomes and accountability across the function. Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of five specialists, ensuring clear responsibilities, strong collaboration, and consistent performance. Establish and manage an integrated operating model connecting data analysis, insights, recommendations, decision-making, execution, performance measurement, and scalability. Identify opportunities to improve client retention, revenue generation, portfolio performance, partner development, and operational efficiency. Transform market intelligence, competitor analysis, and business performance data into actionable recommendations for commercial strategy, product development, and partnership decisions. Develop structured frameworks to identify and capture client growth opportunities, including upselling, cross-selling, promotional activities, and portfolio expansion. Collaborate with Account Management, Partnerships, Product, Operations, and Finance to ensure that strategic recommendations are implemented effectively. Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to introduce AI, automation, and technology-driven improvements that increase productivity, quality, scalability, and cost efficiency. Ensure successful initiatives are documented, standardised, and replicated across relevant clients, markets, and teams. Provide senior leadership with consolidated reporting on business performance, emerging opportunities, operational risks, and recommended actions. Establish transparent performance measurement frameworks, defining baselines, targets, ownership, dependencies, and post-implementation results. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making, accountability, continuous improvement, and commercial ownership. Business Analysis & Performance Insights Analyse client performance, account health indicators, revenue trends, and growth potential. Identify customer churn risks, underperforming segments, and opportunities to increase commercial performance. Support Account Management teams with data-driven recommendations and actionable client insights. Measure and evaluate the impact of client interventions, retention initiatives, and growth strategies. Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights Monitor market developments, competitors, providers, game performance, and player behaviour. Identify emerging market opportunities, competitive threats, and relevant industry trends. Translate market intelligence

jobs.title: Performance Marketing & Creator Success Lead
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Performance Marketing & Creator Success Lead based in United Arab Emirates. We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing & Creator Success Lead to drive profitable acquisition campaigns while delivering outstanding support to partnered creators. In this role, you will manage and optimize paid marketing channels, develop scalable acquisition strategies, and maximize return on advertising spend across multiple creative categories. You will also serve as a trusted partner to creators, providing tailored guidance, proactive communication, and hands-on campaign support. Working within a collaborative, fully remote performance team, you will help strengthen operational processes, improve service quality, and contribute to the development of an evolving business offering. This position combines performance marketing expertise, relationship management, and operational problem-solving to help creative projects reach their full potential. Accountabilities:: Lead the execution and optimization of performance marketing initiatives while ensuring partnered creators receive high-quality support throughout their campaigns. Drive measurable acquisition results, strengthen client relationships, and identify opportunities to improve the team's efficiency and long-term impact. Manage and optimize paid acquisition campaigns across key performance marketing platforms, including Meta, Google, Reddit, and TikTok. Analyze campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities, and implement strategies to maximize return on advertising spend (ROAS) for partnered creators. Develop repeatable, high-impact acquisition strategies aligned with priority creative categories and business objectives. Collaborate with the Operations Manager on longer-term technical and engineering initiatives designed to improve campaign scalability, automation, and performance. Build and maintain strong relationships with advertising platform representatives, external agencies, and other strategic partners to improve campaign outcomes. Act as a primary point of contact for creators, providing proactive communication, timely responses, and personalized guidance throughout their engagement. Adapt campaign recommendations and communication strategies to regional market dynamics, audience behavior, and platform differences. Establish and maintain high standards of creator support, ensuring a consistent and positive service experience. Build trusted relationships with key creators, gather feedback, and translate insights into actionable service and operational improvements. Identify and implement scalable processes, tools, and automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and creator satisfaction. Collaborate with internal teams and external resources to resolve challenges, address systemic issues, and maintain service quality. Support commercial pitches for performance marketing services by helping articulate value propositions and encouraging creators to adopt available offerings. Share knowledge, contribute to team discussions, and continuously improve workflows, service standards, and performance marketing practices. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong performance marketing expertise with exceptional client management and communication skills. You have experience delivering measurable advertising results for crowdfunding campaigns, understand the needs of creators, and can balance analytical decision-making with proactive relationship management. You are collaborative, organized, and comfortable taking ownership of complex challenges while contributing to scalable improvements across a remote team. Extensive experience managing performance marketing campaigns and delivering strong ROAS for crowdfunding projects across multiple creative categories. Three to four years of professional experience managing client

jobs.title: Country manager Rwanda
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Country Manager – Rwanda based in United Arab Emirates. As Country Manager, you will take the lead in strengthening business ecosystems and driving sustainable economic development across Rwanda. You will oversee country-level programmes, build strategic partnerships, and support small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in achieving long-term growth and impact. Working within an international development environment, you will manage a local team, cultivate relationships with institutional donors and business organisations, and identify new funding opportunities. You will play a key role in translating strategic priorities into impactful programmes while ensuring operational excellence and measurable results. Collaborating with regional leadership, programme managers, and international stakeholders, you will help expand organisational influence and create lasting economic, social, and environmental value. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced leader passionate about entrepreneurship, international cooperation, and sustainable development. Accountabilities:: Lead and oversee all country-level activities in Rwanda, ensuring strategic alignment, operational effectiveness, and the successful implementation of development programmes. Identify, develop, and secure funding opportunities from institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and other potential sponsors in collaboration with regional leadership and international partnerships teams. Develop and implement the Country Impact Plan, defining priorities and initiatives that strengthen local business ecosystems and support sustainable SME development. Build and maintain strategic relationships with SMEs, entrepreneurs, business associations, government institutions, NGOs, and other organisations supporting economic development. Strengthen the organisation's local presence, visibility, and credibility by developing partnerships and expanding its professional network throughout Rwanda. Lead and manage the local country team, consisting of freelance representatives, ensuring adequate capacity, motivation, accountability, and performance. Organise regular team meetings, provide guidance, monitor progress, and foster a collaborative, results-driven working environment. Identify and qualify new SME clients according to established assessment criteria, ensuring alignment with diversity, inclusion, environmental sustainability, and social impact objectives. Oversee client relationship management following acquisition, ensuring continuity, high-quality engagement, and alignment with programme objectives. Review and approve client project proposals, ensuring that all relevant information is accurate and complete to facilitate effective matching with appropriate technical experts. Lead professional briefing and debriefing sessions to maintain project quality, capture relevant data, and identify opportunities for organisational learning. Monitor programme performance, analyse relevant data, and provide actionable insights to improve results and strengthen impact. Ensure compliance with organisational policies, quality standards, reporting requirements, and project timelines. Collaborate closely with regional management, programme managers, and international headquarters to coordinate activities and contribute to broader organisational development. Requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, International Development, Economics, or a related field. At least 10 years of professional experience in senior leadership, programme management, business development, or comparable roles involving team leadership and accountability for results. Proven experience securing funding for development programmes, including working with institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and other funding organisations

jobs.title: Sales Team Lead
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Team Lead based in United Arab Emirates. We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Sales Team Lead to oversee a high-performing inbound sales team in a fully remote environment. In this role, you will take ownership of monthly revenue and order targets while driving conversion, commercial performance, and operational excellence. You will coach and develop sales representatives, strengthen their performance, and ensure every lead is managed efficiently throughout the sales pipeline. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will help refine sales strategies, improve processes, and influence broader business decisions. This is a player-coach position that combines strategic oversight with direct involvement in customer interactions, deal management, and daily team operations. It offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to contribute to a growing international business. Accountabilities:: Take full ownership of the inbound sales team's performance, ensuring revenue targets, order volumes, and operational objectives are consistently achieved. Lead by example through active participation in sales activities, hands-on coaching, and continuous process improvement. Own monthly team revenue and order targets, monitor daily performance, and implement corrective actions when results fall behind expectations. Oversee inbound lead management, ensuring fast responses, effective qualification, and consistent follow-up throughout the sales pipeline. Improve lead-to-order conversion rates through better sales practices, process optimization, and performance monitoring. Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, call reviews, and deal reviews, providing actionable feedback to strengthen individual and team performance. Establish clear performance expectations, monitor sales KPIs, and address performance gaps through direct and constructive conversations. Maintain accurate pipeline data and deliver reliable weekly and monthly sales forecasts to leadership. Develop and enforce a structured, repeatable sales process, ensuring all leads, calls, and opportunities are properly documented in the CRM. Drive commercial excellence by identifying upselling and cross-selling opportunities, increasing average order value, applying pricing and discount policies, and protecting margins. Collaborate with Marketing to improve lead quality and work closely with Operations, Production, and Customer Success to ensure customer expectations are met. Share frontline insights with leadership to help shape product development, internal workflows, and broader commercial strategies. Establish a consistent team management rhythm that supports accountability, continuous improvement, and sustainable results. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced sales leader with a proven track record of managing revenue-driven teams, improving commercial performance, and operating effectively in a high-volume inbound sales environment. You combine strong analytical thinking with practical coaching abilities, exceptional communication skills, and a high level of ownership. You are comfortable working independently, adapting quickly to changing priorities, and leading a distributed team with minimal supervision. Demonstrated experience leading an inside sales, inbound sales, or transactional B2B sales team with direct responsibility for revenue targets. Proven ability to deliver measurable team results, supported by concrete figures such as team size, sales targets, and target attainment. Strong commercial understanding of conversion rates, average order value, sales pipelines, forecasting, and profit margins. jobs.title: Non-Executive Director (Cyprus)
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Non-Executive Director (Cyprus) based in United Arab Emirates. We are seeking an experienced governance professional to serve as a Non-Executive Director for a Cyprus-registered company within an international, technology-driven business environment. In this part-time, remote position, you will play an essential role in ensuring corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and the maintenance of appropriate economic substance in Cyprus. You will provide independent oversight without being involved in the company's day-to-day operational activities. Working closely with internal stakeholders, you will review corporate documentation, monitor statutory obligations, and ensure that important decisions and filings are handled accurately and on time. There is also an opportunity to take on Corporate Secretary responsibilities, contributing to the long-term organisation and administration of the business. This role is ideal for a reliable and proactive professional seeking a flexible governance position with the potential to develop a long-term working relationship. Accountabilities:: Act as Non-Executive Director for a Cyprus-registered company, providing appropriate corporate governance oversight and supporting compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Maintain regular communication with internal stakeholders through Slack and email, remaining responsive and accessible during agreed working hours. Review, approve, and sign corporate documents promptly, typically within two hours of receiving a request during working hours. jobs.title: Head of Customer Support
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Support based in United Arab Emirates. As Head of Customer Support, you will lead the transformation and scaling of a multi-brand customer and merchant support organisation within a fast-growing digital marketplace environment. You will bring buyer support, merchant operations, and customer experience teams together under one unified operating model, ensuring consistent service quality and operational efficiency. You will oversee managers and specialised teams while driving the adoption of AI, automation, and innovative customer support technologies. Your mission will be to improve customer satisfaction, optimise operational costs, and create seamless support experiences across multiple brands and markets. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional departments, you will turn customer insights into meaningful product improvements and scalable solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of customer experience in a dynamic, international, and technology-driven business. Accountabilities:: Design, implement, and own a unified customer support operating model across multiple products and brands, defining organisational structures, workflows, routing processes, escalation paths, and decision-making responsibilities. Lead Customer and Merchant Operations, overseeing buyer support across three brands as well as merchant and wholesale support functions. Manage and develop the Customer Experience organisation, including CX Managers, Subject Matter Experts, Training, RCO, automation and chatbot teams, knowledge management, and Quality Assurance. Drive an automation-first customer experience strategy, increasing automated resolution rates and reducing human-agent handoffs while maintaining or improving customer satisfaction and service quality. Lead the development and implementation of AI-powered customer support solutions, including AI assistants and agentic customer service workflows. Establish and monitor key performance indicators, ensuring strong Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Internal Quality Scores (IQS), and Trustpilot performance across buyer and merchant support. Optimise operational efficiency and reduce cost per contact, tracking performance against agreed targets and providing regular reporting to Finance. Analyse customer contact drivers and support data to identify recurring issues, presenting actionable insights to Product teams and driving the elimination of at least two underlying customer pain points per quarter. Collaborate closely with Risk, Payment Operations, Commerce, Product, and Workforce Management teams to improve operational processes and the overall customer journey. Manage external service providers and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partners, ensuring compliance with service-level agreements, operational standards, and internal quality requirements. Develop and mentor Operations Managers and team leads, strengthening leadership capabilities, improving team performance, and establishing a sustainable succession plan. Continuously evaluate support processes, technologies, and organisational structures to ensure the function can scale efficiently as business needs evolve. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience leading Customer Support, Customer Experience, or Customer Operations teams, with a proven track record of building and scaling support functions. Previous experience managing customer support operations within a large-scale digital marketplace or e-commerce environment. Demonstrated success implementing AI-powered customer service solutions and automation initiatives, with measurable results in areas such as automated resolution rates, contact deflection, automation coverage, and cost per contact. Proven ability to manage multi-brand or multi-market customer support operations through a unified organisational and

As Operations Director, you will play a pivotal role in scaling an innovative AgTech business combining artificial intelligence, computer vision, and agricultural technology. You will lead the company's operational strategy, oversee a diverse portfolio of commercial, R&D, and strategic partnership projects, and drive sustainable business growth. Working in an international environment, you will collaborate with customers, research institutions, technology providers, and internal teams across Europe and North America. Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a key Fintech domain, ensuring alignment with broader business objectives and user needs. Lead cross-functional product initiatives from discovery and definition through delivery, collaborating with Engineering, Design, and relevant business stakeholders. Develop and improve financial experiences across cards, payouts, withdrawals, liquidity and advance products, and money movement workflows. Establish and maintain high standards for product quality, documentation, communication, and decision-making. You combine strong product judgment with systems thinking and analytical decision-making, and you are comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment. Strong product sense and systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to understand interconnected workflows and technical dependencies. Data-driven decision-making skills and experience using insights and performance metrics to guide product strategy. Experience working closely with Engineering, Compliance, and Operations teams in a regulated financial environment. Strong understanding of financial products, money movement processes, and the operational considerations involved in delivering reliable financial experiences. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and alignment across diverse stakeholders. A hands-on and proactive approach to product leadership, including requirements definition, issue investigation, debugging, and resolving complex edge cases. Ability to balance strategic ownership with detailed execution in a fast-paced, global environment. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Take full ownership of product quality, ensuring that critical user journeys and revenue-generating funnels work reliably and that production issues are addressed at their root cause. Lead the product delivery rhythm, including daily coordination with engineering and QA, sprint planning, work-in-progress management, and release go/no-go decisions. Write clear, actionable product specifications covering user stories, edge cases, analytics events, acceptance criteria, and test cases, and verify that delivered work meets these standards. Partner with QA to establish regression test coverage for critical revenue journeys and monitor product performance after releases. Define and enforce release standards, ensuring that features are properly tested, instrumented, feature-flagged, rolled out in stages, and monitored. Use Claude, Claude Code, and comparable AI tools daily to conduct research, analyze data, prototype user experiences, write specifications, reproduce bugs, and build small fixes or internal tools where appropriate. Establish AI-first working practices across the product team, including shared prompts, coding conventions, review standards, and design-to-code workflows. Recruit, develop, and lead the product team, including product management, QA, and design capabilities as the business requires; define roles, hiring standards, onboarding, and performance expectations. Own a prioritized product roadmap informed by user research, funnel analytics, and competitor benchmarking, focusing investment on improvements that strengthen quality, conversion, and retention. Maintain ongoing competitor analysis covering product flows, pricing, paywalls, onboarding, and features, using findings to establish and raise product quality benchmarks. Work closely with the Managing Director to align priorities, manage trade-offs, and communicate progress through a consistent reporting cadence. Own D7 and D30 average revenue per user (ARPU) and trial-to-paid conversion, leading pricing, packaging, and paywall experiments from hypothesis and design through rollout and performance analysis. Identify and prioritize new revenue opportunities, including subscription plans, upsells, add-ons, and cross-product usage. Own retention and churn targets, using cohort analysis to identify friction and improve onboarding, engagement loops, cancellation journeys, and customer support experiences. Conduct continuous user discovery through interviews, session recordings, support tickets, reviews, and other feedback sources. Define product metrics and maintain accurate analytics tracking, ensuring decisions are supported by reliable data rather than assumptions. Collaborate with CRO and marketing teams to align landing pages, messaging, onboarding, and product experiences, and coordinate product launches. Requirements: At least 5 years of product management experience with direct-to-consumer subscription products, particularly web-to-web or web-to-app business models, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead product management position. jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Payments)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead the Payments tribe across three cross-functional squads comprising backend, frontend, mobile, and QA engineers, with responsibility for delivery outcomes, engineering quality, team health, and professional development. Coordinate priorities, execution, and dependencies across squads and other engineering teams to ensure predictable delivery and alignment with business objectives. Own people management activities, including performance reviews, career development, compensation and promotion recommendations, hiring, and performance improvement when required. Oversee payment provider and payment method integrations, enabling expansion into new markets and acting as the senior engineering contact for providers during technical escalations. Safeguard the reliability of payment and payout flows by leading incident response, conducting root cause analyses, and driving improvements in payment approval rates, payout processing times, and reconciliation accuracy. Ensure payment systems meet demanding security and compliance standards by minimizing exposure of sensitive data, strengthening security controls, preventing API abuse, and collaborating with Security, Fraud, and Compliance teams on audits and risk mitigation. Maintain robust engineering practices for financial transactions, including idempotency, safe retries, reliable transaction state management, auditability, and consistency across distributed systems. Work closely with Team Leads and Product Managers to clarify requirements, identify technical risks, align priorities, and remove execution obstacles. Improve planning, coordination, development, and release processes as the platform and its portfolio of brands expand. Communicate roadmap progress, delivery commitments, payment performance metrics, technical constraints, and risks to Product, Operations, Finance, and senior leadership. Build a strong understanding of the payment architecture, providers, and engineering workflows during onboarding, and participate in the incident on-call rotation. Drive the continuous improvement of the Payments tribe, with measurable progress in reliability, security, operational performance, and team effectiveness. Proven experience building, operating, or leading teams responsible for systems where financial accuracy is essential, such as payment processing, payouts, digital wallets, billing, ledgers, or banking platforms. Hands-on experience delivering integrations with payment service providers, acquirers, payment orchestration platforms, or payout providers, including an understanding of their operational challenges and failure scenarios. Demonstrated engineering leadership experience managing teams of approximately 15–25 engineers, ideally across multiple squads through Team Leads. jobs.title: Head of Organic Growth

Identify priority markets, domains, and digital assets where the organization can achieve a competitive advantage. Evaluate major strategic opportunities, including AI-powered search, domain or competitor acquisitions, and the development of owned digital asset ecosystems. Assess competitive landscapes and determine where to invest resources, pursue new opportunities, or redirect efforts. Develop clear strategic priorities, budgets, and business cases to support sustainable organic growth. Business Performance & Revenue Ownership Own organic acquisition performance, focusing on conversions and revenue contribution rather than traffic and rankings alone. Drive sustainable growth in organic conversions and organic revenue share. Establish performance objectives, monitor results, and adjust investment decisions based on business impact. Translate insights from organic search into opportunities that can strengthen other acquisition channels and broader business activities. Leadership & Team Development Lead and develop a multidisciplinary organic growth organization covering SEO product management, SEO engineering, and Content & Insights. Provide strategic direction to the SEO engineering function, challenging technical plans and ensuring they support the broader organic growth vision. Build a high-performing, collaborative organization that combines product, technical, content, digital PR, and outreach expertise. Build organizational awareness and accountability around organic search opportunities and performance. Challenge existing approaches constructively and help embed organic growth considerations into broader business decisions. Innovation & Emerging Search Opportunities Monitor developments in traditional search, AI-powered search, and evolving discovery platforms. Evaluate emerging approaches and technologies to maintain a competitive advantage. Identify opportunities to strengthen programmatic SEO, domain authority, and international organic visibility. Encourage experimentation and strategic innovation while maintaining a strong focus on measurable business outcomes. Requirements: Proven track record of scaling an organic growth program, with organic search established as a major acquisition channel. Experience working with a marketplace or consumer-focused scale-up operating at significant scale, ideally with millions of indexed pages. jobs.title: Head of User Acquisition
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead, mentor, and develop a dedicated team of Acquisition Managers, ensuring high standards of execution, accountability, and performance. Own user acquisition strategy and overall campaign performance across an assigned portfolio of high-budget B2C clients with significant advertising investment and international activity. Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including Vice Presidents, Directors, and C-level executives. Lead strategic client discussions, translating business goals into actionable acquisition strategies and performance plans. Present campaign results, provide data-driven insights, and recommend investment priorities and opportunities for further growth. Oversee media buying strategy, advertising budget allocation, campaign testing, optimization, and scaling across the client portfolio. Manage client acquisition activities end to end, ensuring alignment between campaign objectives, execution, and business outcomes. Collaborate with the in-house creative studio to align creative strategy, concepts, and production with campaign performance goals. Contribute to the continuous development of acquisition capabilities, operational processes, and professional standards. Coordinate effectively with distributed teams across Europe and Israel while maintaining strong communication with U.S.-based clients. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in user acquisition and performance marketing, with all required experience gained in the U.S. market. Proven experience directly managing and developing a team. Strong hands-on expertise managing advertising campaigns across both Meta and Google Ads. Demonstrated success in B2C user acquisition and performance-driven marketing. Experience managing advertising budgets exceeding $200,000. Experience working across multiple industry verticals and adapting acquisition strategies to different business models. Strategic thinking combined with a hands-on understanding of campaign management, optimization, and scaling. Strong leadership, client relationship management, analytical, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with international teams and accommodate occasional afternoon or evening meetings to align with U.S. clients. Preferred qualifications: Previous experience working within a performance marketing agency. Hands-on experience with additional paid advertising platforms, particularly TikTok and Snapchat. Benefits: Europe-based remote working opportunity. Opportunity to lead a dedicated team of Acquisition Managers. Strategic ownership of a portfolio of high-budget B2C clients. Direct collaboration with senior executives at U.S.-based companies. Exposure to substantial advertising budgets and international performance marketing campaigns. Collaboration with an in-house creative studio and distributed international teams. Working hours aligned with European time zones, with some afternoon and evening meetings to accommodate U.S. clients.

Coordinate legal activities across multiple jurisdictions and support the development of scalable legal practices. Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and promote knowledge-sharing across the legal function. Commercial Contracts Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of international commercial agreements, including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), OEM agreements, NDAs, procurement and vendor contracts, contractor agreements, and equity-related documents. Provide day-to-day contractual guidance to Sales, Procurement, and other internal teams. Maintain, improve, and standardize contract templates, negotiation playbooks, and internal legal guidance. Ensure contractual arrangements support business objectives while appropriately managing legal and commercial risks. Regulatory Compliance & Corporate Matters Lead export control and dual-use compliance activities across Ukrainian, European Union, and United States regulatory frameworks. Oversee legal audits, due diligence exercises, and cross-functional legal projects. Own the product's business performance, including revenue growth, profitability, long-term value, and investment efficiency. Balance short-term commercial priorities with long-term product investments and allocate resources accordingly. Make strategic decisions regarding the launch, scaling, iteration, or discontinuation of product features and initiatives. Drive improvements in retention, engagement, payer conversion, average revenue per paying user (ARPPU), monetization, lifetime value (LTV), and other key performance indicators. Coordinate launch activities with marketing and development teams, ensuring alignment on priorities and timelines. Partner with marketing leadership on user acquisition, re-engagement economics, and scaling decisions, taking into account the longer payback periods associated with midcore audiences. Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of product updates in collaboration with development leadership and producers. Identify and mitigate product and technical risks, particularly around server-side and social features. Establish transparent cross-functional decision-making processes and contribute to broader product strategy and long-term organizational development. Strengthen product processes and contribute to greater maturity and effectiveness across the wider product function. jobs.title: Sr Account Executive - VIP Segment
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead the full sales cycle, from strategic prospecting and product demonstrations to negotiations and deal closures. Identify, engage, and develop new VIP and high-value enterprise client opportunities. Target large corporations and payroll-based businesses, leveraging existing professional networks while building new sales pipelines. Manage VIP client portfolios, ensuring effective onboarding, strong retention, and opportunities for upselling. Partner with Product and Marketing teams to develop presentations, case studies, and sales materials tailored to SME and enterprise customers. Maintain accurate CRM records, monitor pipeline health, and deliver reliable sales forecasts. Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets. Use business metrics and sales analytics to identify opportunities and continuously improve commercial performance. Requirements: More than 6 years of experience in B2B financial services or SaaS sales, ideally within fintech companies or fast-growing startups. Established network of corporate and large enterprise clients in Mexico, with experience selling to payroll-based businesses. Proven success managing high-value negotiations, strategic relationships, and VIP accounts. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish. Strong knowledge of CRM systems, pipeline management, forecasting, and sales analytics. Customer-focused mindset, with a commitment to delivering an outstanding client experience. Hands-on, entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to take initiative and turn plans into action. Adaptability and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and processes evolve. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. High level of ownership, organization, accountability, and goal orientation. Data-driven approach, with the ability to use performance indicators to guide decisions and improve results. This is a remote position; the original posting specifies candidates based in Mexico City. Benefits: Full-time employment. Remote work arrangement, with the original posting specifying Mexico as the eligible location. Opportunity to contribute to the growth of financial solutions for businesses. Exposure to a fast-paced fintech environment and collaboration across commercial, Product, and Marketing teams. Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, and additional benefits are not specified in the original posting.

jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design, build, and maintain Google Cloud infrastructure using Terraform, ensuring production infrastructure is defined as code and changes are reviewed through pull requests. Operate and continuously improve Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters, including upgrades, capacity planning, autoscaling, networking, and workload isolation. Migrate manually deployed services to Kubernetes, establishing documented, consistent, and repeatable deployment processes. Consolidate configuration, access, and user management across Google Cloud projects into a centralized source of truth. Maintain clearly separated and secure environments for internal services, partner workloads, and future community-facing services. Collaborate with internal engineering teams to migrate their infrastructure to Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes-based environments. Maintain and improve GitHub Actions workflows, applying security best practices such as pinned dependencies, least-privilege tokens, efficient runner usage, and cost controls. Develop and maintain observability capabilities across metrics, logging, and alerting to ensure services are monitored and actionable issues are identified promptly. Apply least-privilege access controls across Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and GitHub, regularly reviewing temporary administrative permissions. Contribute to quarterly and annual technical roadmaps, provide realistic project estimates, and recommend discovery phases for complex initiatives. Take ownership of infrastructure services from design through operation, ensuring reliability, security, scalability, and maintainability. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering, including at least 2 years operating production workloads at a senior level. Strong hands-on experience managing Kubernetes in production, including deployments, networking, upgrades, autoscaling, and troubleshooting. Advanced experience with Terraform, including module design, state management, and infrastructure management across multiple environments. Solid practical knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, particularly GKE, IAM, networking, Pub/Sub, and similar managed services. Experience implementing and operating observability solutions for metrics, logs, and alerting using Grafana or comparable tools. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions, as well as developing and operating containerized services using Docker. Strong understanding of infrastructure security practices, including secrets management, identity and access management (IAM), and least-privilege principles. Solid Linux and networking fundamentals, with scripting skills in Bash. Proven experience migrating manually managed services to Infrastructure as Code. Ability to work independently in a fully remote and asynchronous environment, manage priorities effectively, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. Excellent written and spoken English. Nice to have: Google Cloud certifications, such as Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect, or Kubernetes certifications such as CKA or CKS. Experience operating infrastructure in environments with strict security requirements. Experience managing large-scale push notification infrastructure, including Firebase Cloud Messaging or Apple Push Notification service (APNs). Familiarity with peer-to-peer technologies or distributed systems. Knowledge of Node.js services and their production deployment and operation. Track outstanding IT requests, follow up on agreed actions, and keep colleagues informed until issues are resolved. Coordinate system maintenance, security updates, backups, and recovery arrangements with the external provider, escalating concerns to the Director of Finance and Operations when necessary. Manage user onboarding, access changes, and offboarding, ensuring that permissions are approved and updated promptly. Maintain accurate records of software subscriptions, licences, service contracts, renewal dates, and associated costs, identifying opportunities to reduce unnecessary expenditure. Maintain the IT asset register and coordinate equipment purchasing, allocation, maintenance, replacement, and return. Coordinate support for Microsoft 365, email, domains, website hosting, connectivity, and other shared services. Administer the general information mailbox by directing enquiries to the appropriate colleagues and monitoring follow-up. Support the review and implementation of IT policies and staff guidance, promoting good practices in data protection, information security, and secure information sharing. Systems improvement and staff support Review administrative workflows with departments and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual work, and improve consistency. Support effective use of Monday.com, CRM, Exact Online, Microsoft 365, Box, and other approved digital platforms in collaboration with system owners. Coordinate agreed system changes and improvements with colleagues, service providers, and developers. Develop and maintain practical user guidance and provide onboarding, refresher training, and day-to-day support. Explore appropriate applications of automation and AI to improve efficiency while considering confidentiality, data protection, costs, and the need for human oversight. Test proposed system improvements with users before wider implementation and assess whether they meet operational needs. Document key workflows, system configurations, and provider contacts to ensure continuity and reduce dependency on individual employees. Knowledge management and organizational documentation Develop and maintain an accessible structure for storing, organizing, and retrieving organizational information across approved platforms. Establish clear filing, naming, version-control, and archiving practices with departments and support their consistent implementation. Maintain a central register of policies, procedures, and guidance, including document owners, current versions, approval dates, and review schedules. Coordinate scheduled document reviews and ensure approved materials are accessible to relevant colleagues. Help departments organize shared resources, templates, manuals, and frequently asked questions to improve access to reliable information. Coordinate the documentation and transfer of essential knowledge during onboarding, role changes, and staff departures. Support teams in capturing lessons learned from projects, events, and internal processes for future reference. Coordinate the organization and archiving of legacy files, including Box archives, in line with agreed retention and access requirements. Work with information owners and the external IT provider to ensure confidential records have appropriate access restrictions. Procurement and contract administration Prepare purchase orders based on approved requests, ensuring supplier information, budget codes, amounts, and supporting documentation are accurate and consistent across Monday.com and Exact Online. Check procurement requests against internal procurement policies before submitting them for approval. jobs.title: Senior Executive, Quality Systems
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Manage and conduct deviation investigations in accordance with established Quality Systems procedures and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements. Perform thorough root cause analyses and ensure appropriate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) are implemented, monitored, and completed effectively. Investigate and support the resolution of Product Quality Complaints, ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners to facilitate the timely investigation and closure of quality events. Prepare clear, accurate, and comprehensive investigation reports, supporting documentation, and quality records. Analyze trends in deviations, CAPAs, and product complaints to identify recurring issues and opportunities for continuous improvement. Support broader Quality Systems activities, including quality metrics, risk assessments, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) development, and Management Review processes. Contribute to the maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) processes. Take ownership of assigned activities, make timely decisions, and adapt effectively to changing priorities and challenges. Promote collaboration across business functions by working openly and respectfully with colleagues and external partners. Demonstrate accountability, integrity, initiative, and a continuous improvement mindset while contributing to a strong quality culture. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Microbiology, or another relevant scientific discipline. Approximately 4–6 years of experience in Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, Compliance, Manufacturing QA, or a related function. Hands-on experience managing deviations and/or Product Quality Complaints within a pharmaceutical environment. Proven ability to prepare investigation reports and manage CAPAs through to effective completion. Practical knowledge of Root Cause Analysis methodologies and quality investigation tools. Good understanding of GMP requirements and quality risk management principles. Familiarity with ICH Q9, ICH Q10, and EudraLex Volume 4 GMP guidelines. Experience working with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS); familiarity with Veeva Vault, QDocs, or TraceLink is an advantage. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders and external manufacturing organizations. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, analytical laboratories, sterile products, or biosimilars is beneficial. A proactive, solutions-oriented approach, with the ability to embrace change, take initiative, and make timely decisions. Strong learning agility, adaptability, and commitment to continuous professional development. Ability to work collaboratively across different functions and contribute positively to an inclusive, fast-growing environment. Benefits: Agile and flexible working arrangements. Work-from-anywhere opportunities, subject to local legislation. Global employee recognition program. Long-service awards. Employee Assistance Programme. Birthday leave. Dedicated wellbeing day. Volunteering leave. Compassionate leave. Comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to support employee wellbeing and work-life balance. Opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development. A collaborative and inclusive international environment where employees can contribute to meaningful healthcare outcomes.

jobs.title: Head of Payments
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take end-to-end ownership of payment platforms and infrastructure across multiple DTC brands, overseeing quality assurance, reporting, documentation, and continuous performance analysis. Act as the primary point of contact for all payment-related matters, supporting internal brand and operations teams as well as external payment service providers (PSPs). Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation covering payment flows, platform configurations, integrations, and provider setups for each brand. Lead payment infrastructure setup for new brands, including PSP integrations, merchant account verification, business onboarding, and payment configuration. Ensure all payment systems and integrations are properly configured, tested, and fully operational before new brand launches. Research, evaluate, and test new payment providers, developing strategies for integrating additional PSPs into the existing payment ecosystem. Analyze and compare payment provider performance based on transaction fees, authorization rates, reliability, and customer support quality. Continuously monitor payment performance across all brands and identify opportunities to improve transaction acceptance and authorization rates. Optimize payment routing, retry logic, checkout configurations, and other payment processes to maximize successful transactions. Monitor fraud trends and configure fraud prevention rules and filters to balance transaction approval rates with financial risk exposure. Manage the complete dispute, claim, and chargeback process across all payment providers, including Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms. Gather supporting documentation, prepare compelling representment cases, and submit evidence within payment provider deadlines. Analyze dispute reason codes and identify recurring patterns, translating insights into recommendations for checkout improvements, customer policies, and Customer Support processes. Monitor payment provider account health, including dispute ratios, reserve requirements, risk status, and relevant monitoring programs such as VAMP and SAFE. Identify potential account risks early and implement corrective actions to maintain healthy payment processing relationships. Develop and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering key payment performance indicators. Present payment performance, account health, emerging risks, and optimization opportunities to senior leadership and relevant stakeholders. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Payment acceptance and authorization rates. Fraud rates and associated financial losses. Payment processing fees and effective transaction costs across providers. Payment service provider account health, including account standing, reserves, and risk status. Dispute and chargeback rates. Requirements: At least 2 years of professional experience in payments, fraud prevention, or financial risk management, preferably within e-commerce or direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses. Hands-on experience managing payment service providers such as Stripe, PayPal, or similar platforms. Practical experience handling payment disputes, chargebacks, and representment processes. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to build and maintain KPI dashboards, analyze transaction data, and identify actionable performance insights. Familiarity with fraud prevention tools, 3D Secure (3DS), and payment provider risk management programs, including dispute ratio thresholds and monitoring requirements. Experience onboarding new merchant accounts, configuring payment systems, and managing payment integrations. Understanding of payment authorization processes, transaction routing, processing fees, and fraud prevention strategies. Excellent written communication skills, particularly for preparing dispute evidence, maintaining technical documentation, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple pay
