jobs.title: Producer (Video Production)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Manage specialized production projects across video, motion, 3D, and AR, from briefing and planning through execution and final delivery. Oversee the production of brand films, digital advertisements, and modular content designed for performance marketing and other digital channels. Collaborate with Creative Leads, Directors of Photography (DOPs), editors, scriptwriters, and other creative specialists to ensure high-quality production outcomes. Coordinate global video shoots, whether on-site or remotely directed, and manage external production vendors when required. Support the adoption and integration of AI-powered tools for scripting, storyboarding, post-production, and asset creation where they add value. Manage production budgets, schedules, licensing requirements, and deliverables across social media, Connected TV, digital advertising, and other channels. Partner with AR and 3D specialists to deliver interactive and immersive content, understanding the key stages and requirements of these projects. Build and maintain a trusted international network of production suppliers, including crew, equipment providers, studios, and specialized service partners. Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, strengthen operational efficiency, and develop scalable ways of working. Work closely with Creative Project Managers, Creative Directors, Finance teams, and customers to align expectations and project objectives. Maintain clear communication and coordination throughout the production lifecycle, ensuring all stakeholders remain informed on scope, planning, shoot execution, and post-production. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in creative production within an agency, in-house team, or production company. Strong hands-on experience managing video shoots, post-production workflows, and digital-first content for both organic and paid channels. Experience working with performance marketing teams or producing content optimized for testing, iteration, and campaign performance is an advantage. Comfortable working in global, remote, and asynchronous environments, with the flexibility to collaborate across different time zones. Familiarity with AI, AR, and emerging creative technologies, alongside a genuine interest in testing and applying new tools thoughtfully. Proven experience managing external vendors, production budgets, contracts, and licensing requirements. Strong project management and organizational skills, with a process-oriented mindset and a focus on structure, efficiency, and reliable delivery. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, with the confidence to coordinate diverse creative and business teams. A proactive, collaborative, and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to take ownership, adapt to challenges, and solve problems effectively. Flexibility to accommodate occasional irregular schedules and international production requirements. Benefits: Fully remote working model, with the flexibility to work from different locations. Opportunity to collaborate with a global team representing more than 60 nationalities and working across multiple time zones. High-trust, collaborative environment that values direct feedback, continuous learning, and low-ego teamwork. Opportunities to take on meaningful responsibilities and contribute ideas that shape the evolution of global creative production. Access to mentorship, professional development, and opportunities for career growth. Opportunity to work with ambitious international brands and contribute to innovative, AI-enabled creative projects. Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, and other specific financial benefits are not detailed in the available job description.

jobs.title: Senior Group Accounting Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Act as a subject matter expert on complex accounting and reporting topics, particularly consolidation matters involving Variable Interest Entities (VIE) and Voting Interest Entities (VOE), supplier finance programs, and financial instruments. Ensure accurate and timely Group financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements. Define, develop, and implement Group-wide accounting and reporting standards, policies, and guidelines. Review, validate, and process financial information submitted by subsidiaries, contributing to the preparation of public Group financial reports. Lead and contribute to Group-wide accounting projects, particularly those involving the implementation of new and updated US GAAP standards. Organize and deliver internal and external training sessions on key accounting topics, helping stakeholders understand complex requirements and their practical implications. Serve as the primary point of contact for external Group auditors and coordinate accounting-related audit matters. Collaborate with international subsidiaries, Group functions, and business areas to ensure consistent accounting practices and effective reporting processes. Requirements: University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline; a Master's degree is preferred. At least 5 years of professional experience in technical accounting and financial reporting under US GAAP. U.S. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification is highly preferred. Strong expertise in Group Accounting, consolidation, and the application of complex US GAAP standards. International professional experience within a multinational organization; experience in the industrial sector is an advantage. Excellent analytical skills and a structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to complex accounting challenges. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical accounting matters clearly and provide practical guidance and training. Proven stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across different organizational levels and geographical locations. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, international, and fast-paced environment. Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the opportunity to work worldwide. Fixed-term employment contract. Opportunity to work on complex Group accounting and financial reporting topics in an international environment. Exposure to strategic accounting projects, including the implementation of evolving US GAAP standards. Collaboration with international subsidiaries, Group functions, and external auditors. Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, and additional benefits are not specified in the available job description.

jobs.title: Human Resources Director | Head Office
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Operationalize and scale the People operating model, including organizational structure, roles, service delivery, processes, and governance across the holding. Ensure efficient, high-quality People services that adapt to changing business requirements and the maturity of individual business units. Develop and maintain a People metrics framework and dashboard to support data-driven decisions and measure HR effectiveness. Lead talent management initiatives focused on attracting, retaining, and developing top talent, including succession planning and knowledge continuity for critical roles. Support managers and leaders in strengthening their capabilities and addressing business-critical people challenges. Partner with senior stakeholders across the organization to identify strategic HR priorities and deliver initiatives aligned with business objectives. Own People risk management and ensure HR practices are aligned with the broader organizational risk framework. Embed the desired organizational culture and Code of Conduct into key People processes and reinforce consistent standards across the business. Oversee HR systems, ensuring they meet business needs, comply with company standards, achieve strong adoption, and improve continuously. Lead, coach, and develop the People team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and alignment with organizational priorities. Requirements: 10+ years of HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role such as Head of People, HR Director, CPO, or CHRO within a fast-growing, high-performance environment. Proven experience building or transforming a People function within a holding, group of companies, or technology organization with business units at different stages of maturity. Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and scale HR operating models. Strong expertise in people analytics and the development of data-driven decision-making frameworks. Proven people leadership skills, including the ability to develop experienced professionals, delegate effectively, and build autonomous, accountable teams. Strong change management capabilities and experience guiding organizations through transformation. Practical experience using automation and AI to improve HR processes, service delivery, and operational efficiency. Ability to partner with senior business leaders, constructively challenge perspectives, and influence strategic decisions. Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect People strategies and decisions to business performance, costs, and organizational outcomes. Upper-intermediate English proficiency or higher, both written and spoken. Strategic mindset combined with a strong execution focus, ownership, accountability, and the ability to deliver results without micromanagement. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills. Resilience and adaptability when working in complex, fast-changing environments. Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority. A business-oriented, service-minded approach, supported by high standards, openness to feedback, and continuous improvement. Nice to have: Experience leading large-scale organizational change initiatives. Strong negotiation and conflict management skills. Background in service-based businesses, such as outsourcing, outstaffing, or professional services. Experience developing Employee Experience as a measurable system. Previous experience in operations. Benefits: 28 business days of paid time off. Flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely. Medical insurance and mental health support. Financial support for courses and professional training. English language classes and speaking clubs. Access to an internal library and educational events. Corporate events, celebrations, and team-building activities.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Bot Detection (Client-Side & Signals)
jobs.description: Thispositionislistedonbehalfofapartnercompany,whomanagesallapplicationsandnextsteps.OurpartnerislookingforaSeniorSoftwareEngineer,BotDetection(Client-Side&Signals)basedin Portugal. AsaSeniorSoftwareEngineer,youwillplayakeyroleinprotectingalarge-scale,open-sourceAIplatformfromautomatedabuseandmaliciousbotactivity.Youwilldesign,develop,anddeployadvanceddetectionmechanismsthatdistinguishlegitimateusersfromautomatedtrafficacrosswebapplications,APIs,anddevelopertools.Workingattheintersectionofbrowsertechnologies,networkprotocols,securityengineering,andbehavioralanalytics,youwillbuildinnovativesolutionsthatadapttoincreasinglysophisticatedautomationtechniques.YouwillcollaboratecloselywithTrust&Safety,infrastructure,andengineeringteamstostrengthenplatformsecuritywhilepreservingaseamlessuserexperience.Thisisanopportunitytotakeownershipofaspecializedtechnicalinitiativewithinahighlycollaborative,remote-first,andopen-source-orientedenvironment. Accountabilities: Design, develop, and deploy production-ready bot detection signals across multiple platform surfaces, including browser applications, APIs, Git/LFS, command-line tools, and client libraries. Build and maintain browser and device fingerprinting capabilities, client-side challenges, TLS/HTTP fingerprinting mechanisms, and behavioral telemetry systems. Investigate real-world bot technologies and automation techniques, including headless browsers, anti-detect browsers, residential proxies, and CAPTCHA-solving services. Develop and continuously improve countermeasures against sophisticated automated abuse, adapting detection strategies as malicious actors evolve their techniques. Analyze browser behavior, network characteristics, and client interactions to identify patterns that distinguish human users from automated systems. Collaborate with data-focused detection engineers to transform raw telemetry and collected signals into reliable detection features and actionable decisions. Work closely with infrastructure, security, and platform engineering teams to implement mitigation strategies, including rate limiting, additional verification challenges, and enforcement mechanisms. Ensure detection systems operate reliably and efficiently at scale while minimizing friction for legitimate developers, researchers, and API users. Apply privacy-conscious engineering principles when collecting and processing behavioral and technical signals. Contribute to open-source tooling, technical documentation, research, and knowledge-sharing initiatives whenever appropriate. Requirements Proven hands-on experience in bot detection, anti-fraud engineering, browser fingerprinting, web security, or a closely related technical discipline. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining production-grade detection systems. Deep understanding of browser internals and web technologies, including JavaScript, the DOM, rendering APIs, WebGL, Canvas, Audio APIs, and browser extensions. Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, particularly HTTP/2, HTTP/3, and TLS. Practical understanding of browser automation tools and techniques, including Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium, stealth plugins, and other automation frameworks. Strong programming skills in TypeScript and JavaScript, alongside proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust. Ability to investigate sophisticated automation techniques, understand how they operate, and translate findings into effective detection and prevention strategies. Experience building pragmatic technical solutions, prioritizing production impact, continuous improvement, and adaptability over unnecessary complexity. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical challenges. A strong commitment to user privacy and the ability to balance effective abuse prevention with a smooth experience for legitimate users. Nice-to-have qualifications: Published resear

jobs.title: Senior User Acquisition Manager / UA Lead (Meta Ads)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Personally launch, manage, optimise and scale Meta Ads campaigns targeting the US market, taking full ownership of paid acquisition performance and significant monthly budgets. Manage web-based acquisition funnels end to end, including landing pages, quizzes, offers, checkout experiences and subscription flows. Partner with the Creative Manager, designers and UGC creators to develop creative hypotheses, briefs, hooks, angles and formats, then test and iterate campaigns at pace. Research competitor advertising, US consumer behaviour and successful creative approaches, translating insights into structured experiments and scalable acquisition strategies. Ensure reliable campaign tracking and measurement through Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), event quality monitoring, funnel events and multi-touch attribution. Own budget allocation and scaling decisions using key performance indicators, including CPA, CAC, ROAS, LTV, payback periods and cohort performance. Collaborate with CRO, Product and Analytics teams to improve landing pages, funnel conversion rates, offer performance and overall acquisition efficiency. Explore additional paid acquisition channels, such as Google, YouTube and TikTok, once Meta performance is strong and predictable. Establish clear reporting practices, experimentation routines and effective cross-functional workflows. jobs.title: Research Analyst, Fuel Oil
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. Key Responsibilities: Analyse fuel oil and bunker market drivers: Track pricing dynamics, crack spreads, refinery margins, and marine fuel demand across HSFO, VLSFO, SRFO, and VGO, summarizing key drivers for the team . Contribute to core research outputs: Draft analytical sections, charts, and data tables for weekly market reports and Market Pulse updates under senior review . Monitor operational and regulatory shifts: Track refinery outages, planned maintenance, sanctions, regulatory updates, and infrastructure developments to flag items impacting the fuel oil complex . Leverage and validate proprietary data: Use Kpler’s trade, flow, inventory, and supply-demand datasets to support commentary, proactively raising questions or apparent anomalies with internal data teams . Support client and commercial engagement: Respond to straightforward client and internal inquiries, and prepare data-backed slides and analysis for webinars, presentations, and pre-sales activities . Identify intelligence opportunities: Share observations on emerging market trends and data coverage gaps with senior analysts to continuously enhance Kpler’s product offering . Experience & Background: 1–3 years of experience in oil market analysis, energy, commodities, or maritime shipping (relevant internships and graduate programs count) . Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (such as Economics, Engineering, Finance, or Data Science), or equivalent practical experience . Strong foundational knowledge of physical oil markets, including refined products, refinery operations, and supply-demand dynamics . Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel with comfort organizing, cleaning, and interpreting structured supply-demand and pricing datasets . Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail and a collaborative approach across teams and time zones . Nice-to-haves: Direct exposure to fuel oil markets—particularly dirty petroleum products (such as HSFO, VLSFO, SRFO, or VGO)—bunkering operations, or IMO 2020 market dynamics . Hands-on familiarity with Kpler platforms or other commodity and vessel-tracking data tools . Basic programming or querying skills in Python or similar data analysis tools . Spoken and written Arabic language skills alongside an active interest in Middle East energy markets .

jobs.title: Content Strategist / UGC Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Manage client campaigns end to end, coordinating creator rosters across multiple markets. Develop weekly video hooks, scripts, and creative directions tailored to each platform and audience. Run high-volume creative experiments, testing hooks, formats, pacing, text styles, and calls to action. Monitor campaign performance daily, identify emerging trends, discontinue underperforming content approaches, and scale successful formats quickly. Translate performance data into actionable creative recommendations and repeatable campaign playbooks. Coach creators through clear, specific, and practical feedback, using examples from successful videos to improve content quality and results. Manage creator rosters by identifying high performers, supporting creators who need improvement, and making decisions about roster retention. Source, recruit, and onboard new creators as campaign needs evolve. Maintain oversight of multiple clients, creators, and experiments while ensuring campaigns remain organized and results-focused. Requirements: Strong familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and current short-form video culture, with an instinctive understanding of what resonates online. A proactive, high-ownership mindset, with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks. Strong creative writing skills, particularly the ability to develop platform-native hooks, scripts, and creator feedback without relying on conventional marketing language. A systems-oriented approach, capable of turning creative experimentation into structured, repeatable processes. Comfort with publishing or creating content personally and evaluating performance metrics in real time. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage several creators, campaigns, and tests simultaneously. Commercial awareness and an understanding of how content performance contributes to client growth and business objectives. Resilience, curiosity, and a willingness to treat unsuccessful experiments as learning opportunities. Genuine motivation to learn, take responsibility, and grow in a fast-paced environment. Previous industry experience is not required. Experience in UGC, creator management, social media, or growth marketing is an advantage. Additional language skills are considered a plus, particularly when supporting campaigns across different markets. Benefits: Annual base salary of €35,000–€50,000, depending on experience. Performance-based bonuses and equity opportunities. Full-time, permanent employment. Fully remote, remote-first working environment, with flexibility to work from anywhere. Meaningful ownership and responsibility from the first week. Opportunity to work on campaigns for established consumer brands and apps. Exposure to an in-house app studio and the opportunity to apply distribution strategies to products directly. Clear progression toward a Senior UGC Engineer position, with compensation, bonuses, and equity opportunities growing alongside performance. Quarterly team trips and opportunities to connect with colleagues in person. Unlimited paid time off, with the team typically taking approximately 23 days per year. Collaborative environment within a young, ambitious team that values energy, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Identification Accuracy
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Serve as the primary analytics contact for identification accuracy questions from Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams. Investigate reported false positives and false negatives, identify root causes, and communicate findings in a clear, actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Lead accuracy analyses for strategic customers and prospective clients, developing customer-specific metrics using their own data, such as account identifiers, when standard measurement approaches are insufficient. Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports supporting Customer Success and Sales Engineering, including customer accuracy health reports and weekly portfolio performance summaries. Build and maintain self-service analytics tools, including AI-assisted solutions, enabling internal teams to resolve routine accuracy questions without relying on analyst support. Encourage adoption of self-service tools and improve how teams access, interpret, and use identification accuracy data. Model and maintain analytics datasets using dbt and ClickHouse, including aggregate tables, incremental models, and data quality tests. Ensure analytical datasets and reporting solutions remain performant, reliable, accurate, and properly documented. Monitor identification accuracy metrics, investigate time-series trends, and detect anomalies before they affect customers. Document analytical findings, investigation methods, and reusable playbooks to strengthen knowledge sharing across the organization. Promote an engineering-focused, data-driven culture by sharing effective analytics practices, tools, and technical knowledge. Participate in a shared on-call rotation, following a schedule communicated in advance and designed to distribute coverage fairly while minimizing disruption outside working hours. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Science, or a closely related discipline. Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international remote team. Advanced SQL proficiency, including common table expressions (CTEs), window functions, and efficient querying of large event-level datasets. Solid statistical knowledge, including metric design, impact measurement, and the ability to distinguish meaningful changes from statistical noise. Practical experience with analytical data platforms such as ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. Experience developing dashboards and working with data visualization tools such as Apache Superset, Tableau, Metabase, or Looker. Strong programming skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable code. Familiarity with Git, version control, and collaborative software development workflows. Demonstrated ability to investigate data discrepancies, identify anomalies, and reconcile analytical results with customer or stakeholder calculations. Experience supporting internal business teams through the management and prioritization of data and reporting requests according to urgency and business impact. Confidence conducting ad hoc analyses and presenting findings to cross-functional teams. Excellent communication and presentation skills, particularly when explaining complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and customer-facing colleagues. Familiarity with data transformation frameworks and approaches such as dbt, materialized views, incremental models, and data pipeline tools is an advantage. Experience with Python analytics libraries and tools, including NumPy, pandas, and Jupyter, is beneficial and expected for Senior Data Analyst-level candidates. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, coding agents, or MCP to automate analytical workflows or develop internal tools is a plus. Understanding of machine learning fundamentals

jobs.title: English Content Writer (AI-Assisted)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will manage an AI-assisted content production workflow from initial brief review through final editorial delivery. Your responsibilities will include: - AI-Assisted Content Production Use AI tools and established writing guidelines to develop content briefs, first drafts, and editorial reviews for assigned topics. Review AI-generated briefs to ensure that keywords, article angles, and proposed structures are relevant and accurate before drafting begins. Identify missing information, inconsistencies, and unsuitable recommendations, applying editorial judgment throughout the process. - Writing and Editorial Quality Ensure every article addresses the reader's search intent and provides clear, relevant, and useful information. Rewrite generic or unnatural AI-generated passages into specific, engaging, and human-sounding content. Maintain a consistent editorial voice using clear language, short sentences, and American English spelling. Proofread existing articles for grammar, readability, clarity, and factual accuracy. - Fact-Checking and Research Verify legal, tax, payroll, and other regulatory information using reliable official government sources. Confirm that all figures and factual statements are current and accurate. Add relevant inline links to official sources to support important claims. - SEO, GEO, and Content Optimization Apply SEO and GEO guidelines to keyword placement, headings, FAQ sections, and internal linking. Ensure article structures are optimized for traditional search engines and AI-powered search tools. Prepare and optimize visual assets by sourcing images through Canva, converting them to WebP format under 150 KB, and writing descriptive alt text. - Collaboration and Revisions Submit completed articles to the content lead for review. Incorporate feedback and complete up to two rounds of revisions per article. Meet agreed delivery deadlines and maintain consistent quality across assignments. Requirements : The ideal candidate is an experienced English writer with strong editorial judgment and the ability to work effectively with AI-generated content. You should be comfortable researching complex topics, identifying factual inaccuracies, and applying SEO principles to produce clear, trustworthy articles. The following qualifications are expected: Native-level English writing and editing skills, with excellent grammar and a natural, polished writing style. Strong working knowledge of SEO principles, including search intent, keyword placement, and heading structure. Understanding of GEO and how AI-powered search tools discover, interpret, and present content. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for professional content creation. Ability to identify generic, inaccurate, or unnatural AI-generated text and rewrite it into clear, human-sounding content. Strong fact-checking and research skills, including the ability to locate and interpret official government sources. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to assess the accuracy, relevance, and completeness of content. Ability to manage assignments independently and meet deadlines. Additional qualifications that would be an advantage: Previous B2B content writing experience, particularly in HR technology, fintech, or SaaS. Familiarity with Google's E-E-A-T principles: Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness. Basic knowledge of global remote work, international employment, cross-border compliance, payroll, or Employer of Record (EOR) services. Experience with prompt-based or multi-step AI content workflows. Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Ubersuggest. Access to a Canva Pro account for sourcing a wider range of visual assets. Benefits: Fully remote freelance opportunity, open to writers worldwide. Paid per article, with compensation based on the type and complexity of the assignment: Full article, from brief to final draft including images: starting at USD 50. Proofread

jobs.title: UGC Creator, Short-Form Video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a UGC Creator, you will produce original short-form content designed to connect with travel enthusiasts and communicate the value of group travel. Your main responsibilities will include: Create and publish at least one unique short-form video per day throughout the 30-day campaign. Produce engaging content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, cross-posting each original video across all three platforms. Develop attention-grabbing opening hooks that capture viewers' interest within the first few seconds. Translate campaign prompts and structured concepts into natural, relatable videos that feel like conversations with friends. Use trending audio, CapCut templates, and current short-form video formats to maximize engagement. Build and manage dedicated social media accounts focused exclusively on the campaign. Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and deliver content independently, without requiring close supervision. Represent the campaign on camera, communicating its message through authentic and energetic storytelling. Requirements: The ideal candidate is a confident content creator with a strong interest in travel, social media trends, and community-driven experiences. You should be comfortable producing videos independently, appearing on camera, and connecting with an audience through relatable storytelling. The following qualifications are expected: Between 18 and 30 years old. Based in the United States, European Union, Canada, or the United Kingdom. Able to create and publish at least one video per day consistently. Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Strong understanding of trending audio, short-form video formats, and engaging content hooks. Experience with fast-paced video editing tools such as CapCut, Canva, or similar platforms. Comfortable being the face of a social media channel and delivering scripted or structured prompts naturally. Creative, energetic, reliable, and able to work independently. Genuine enthusiasm for travel and an understanding of the challenges of organizing trips with friends. A belief in making group travel accessible to people who do not want to travel alone. Previous experience using the platform, or an active background as a backpacker, study-abroad student, or digital nomad, is a plus. Benefits: Compensation: €20 per unique video, cross-posted across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Campaign duration: 30 days, with a target of one video per day. Total earning potential: €600 for completing the full 30-day campaign. Fully remote freelance opportunity. Opportunity to create content around travel, exploration, and shared experiences. Top-performing creators may receive opportunities to join fully funded or sponsored group trips and create content while traveling. Quick audition process focused on content creation rather than a traditional CV. Expected start date: As soon as possible.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture. Practical experience in architectural design, building planning, or permitting processes is highly desirable. Familiarity with BIM software such as Revit or Archicad is advantageous. Experience with parametric design tools such as Grasshopper is a plus. Strong understanding of architectural planning workflows and customer decision-making processes. Previous experience in key account management, consulting, or customer-facing project management is highly valued. A forward-deployed mindset, with the ability to work directly with customers, take ownership of their success, and act as a bridge between customer teams and engineers. jobs.title: Medical Writer II OR Senior Medical Writer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Compile, write, edit, and coordinate medical writing deliverables for clinical study and regulatory projects, working with minimal supervision. Prepare and support a range of clinical and regulatory documents, including clinical study protocols and amendments, clinical study reports, patient narratives, annual reports, and investigator brochures. Mentor less experienced medical writers on projects when required. Review statistical analysis plans and table, figure, and listing specifications to ensure appropriate content, grammar, formatting, and consistency. Collaborate with colleagues in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, and other relevant departments to deliver accurate and complete documentation. Participate in internal peer reviews, addressing comments and ensuring scientific accuracy, clarity, consistency, and appropriate formatting. Ensure all deliverables comply with applicable regulatory standards and guidance, including ICH-E3, as well as relevant standard operating procedures, client requirements, and approved templates. Conduct online clinical literature searches when needed to support writing assignments. Keep up to date with changes in regulatory guidance, medical writing practices, and client expectations. Monitor project budgets and allocated hours, communicating any anticipated changes to medical writing leadership. Complete administrative responsibilities within established deadlines and undertake other related duties as assigned. Be available for occasional travel, expected to remain below 25%. Requirements: A Bachelor of Science degree with relevant writing experience, or a Bachelor of Arts degree, preferably in Social Sciences, English, or Communications, supported by relevant scientific or medical knowledge and expertise. Extensive knowledge of English grammar and strong medical and scientific writing skills. Familiarity with FDA and ICH regulations and guidelines, as well as the AMA style guide. Understanding of clinical research principles and the drug development process. Ability to interpret and communicate clinical data and other complex scientific information accurately and clearly. Strong proofreading, editing, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines and budgets. Leadership skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach, including the ability to support and mentor colleagues. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, email, and internet-based research tools. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain consistency and accuracy across complex regulatory documents. Benefits: Remote working arrangement within the eligible European locations. Full-time employment. Career development and progression opportunities. Supportive and engaged line management. Technical and therapeutic-area training. Peer recognition and a total rewards program. Opportunities to collaborate with international specialists across clinical and regulatory functions. Exposure to emerging technologies, scientific developments, data, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Opportunities to explore different career paths within a global life sciences environment. Salary, healthcare coverage, and specific additional financial benefits are not detailed in the available job information.

jobs.title: Senior Artificial Intelligence Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design, build, and operate production-grade AI agent infrastructure and scalable LLM-powered services. Develop agent orchestration systems, stateful workflows, and durable execution mechanisms, including checkpointing, retries, and failure recovery. Build integrations based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling secure and reliable tool execution. Develop reusable platform components, APIs, and SDKs to support agent-based applications. Architect scalable and fault-tolerant AI services on AWS, including LLM gateways, model routing, fallback mechanisms, and cost controls. Implement observability, tracing, and evaluation capabilities for agentic workflows. Optimize system performance, latency, scalability, and infrastructure costs. Establish authentication, authorization, and access-control mechanisms for agents and tools. Integrate human-in-the-loop approvals and execution safeguards to strengthen system security and governance. Define and promote engineering standards for reliable, maintainable, and secure AI systems. Take ownership of technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to production support. Requirements: At least 5 years of software engineering experience, with strong expertise in Python backend development. Proven experience building and operating LLM-powered systems in production environments. Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent technologies. Practical knowledge of LLM APIs, tool and function calling, and agentic workflows. Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and fault-tolerant architectures. Experience with Python type safety, data validation, and schema management using Pydantic or equivalent tools. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, as well as Docker and CI/CD practices. Understanding of API security, authentication, and authorization principles. Solid engineering fundamentals, including system design, testing, debugging, and observability. Ability to independently design, implement, and operate complex technical components. Additional experience with LangGraph, LangChain, MCP servers and gateways, durable workflows, checkpointing, and distributed state management is considered an advantage. Familiarity with LLM gateways, model routing, caching, inference optimization, and agent evaluation tools such as MLflow, Langfuse, and OpenTelemetry is a plus. Experience with Kubernetes (particularly EKS), event-driven architectures, platform engineering, agent sandboxing, human-in-the-loop workflows, RAG architectures, or vector databases is also beneficial. Relevant technologies include Python, SQL, LangGraph, LangChain, Pydantic, MCP, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS services (EKS, Lambda, S3, SQS, IAM), Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, and event-driven systems. Benefits: Annual flexible benefits budget that can be allocated across sports, medical care, mental health support, home-office needs, and language learning. Paid maternity and paternity leave, along with a monthly childcare allowance. More than 20 vacation days, unlimited sick leave, and emergency time off. Remote-first working environment, with technical support and coworking compensation. Online and in-person team events, including offsite gatherings. Learning and development opportunities through internal courses and growth programs. Salary and additional compensation details are not specified.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - M&A
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Business Analyst – M&A based in India. We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Senior Business Analyst to support complex mergers and acquisitions, strategic investments, divestitures, and business partnerships across multiple industries. In this role, you will combine financial expertise, strategic thinking, and rigorous market analysis to evaluate investment opportunities and support high-impact corporate transactions. You will contribute throughout the entire M&A lifecycle, from opportunity identification and due diligence to valuation, negotiation, and deal execution. Working with international stakeholders and specialist advisors, you will assess financial performance, operational capabilities, market positioning, and transaction risks. You will also help shape corporate strategy by identifying growth opportunities, evaluating business portfolios, and developing investment recommendations. This is an opportunity to contribute to major strategic decisions within a fast-paced, globally distributed, and innovation-driven environment. Accountabilities: Conduct comprehensive commercial, financial, and operational due diligence on acquisition targets, investment opportunities, and strategic assets, coordinating insights from legal, tax, technical, and other specialist advisors. Develop, maintain, and review sophisticated financial models, including Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Leveraged Buyout (LBO), merger and accretion/dilution, sum-of-the-parts, comparable company, and precedent transaction analyses. Support the complete M&A transaction lifecycle, from deal origination, opportunity screening, and valuation to transaction structuring, negotiation support, and closing, across both buy-side and sell-side activities. Contribute to corporate and business-unit strategy projects, including market sizing, industry research, competitive benchmarking, growth strategy development, portfolio assessments, and investment thesis preparation. Prepare high-quality investment memoranda, information memoranda, pitch books, valuation reports, and presentations for senior management, boards, and investment committees. Monitor M&A transactions, capital markets, industry developments, and competitive trends to identify and prioritize potential investment and partnership opportunities. Coordinate transaction execution activities, including data room management, collaboration with legal teams and external advisors, communication with counterparties, and review of transaction documentation such as term sheets, Share Purchase Agreements (SPAs), and shareholder agreements. Evaluate regulatory, geopolitical, environmental, social, and governance (ESG), and integration-related risks, contributing to synergy assessments and post-merger integration planning. Analyze and structure alternative transaction arrangements, including asset and share acquisitions, joint ventures, minority investments, earn-outs, deferred and contingent consideration, and structured or hybrid financing solutions. Assess the financial, commercial, and counterparty implications of different transaction structures, including royalties, streams, prepayments, and offtake agreements. Translate complex financial and operational findings into clear, actionable recommendations that support strategic and investment decisions. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mergers and acquisitions, investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity, corporate development, or strategy consulting. Hands-on experience supporting or executing live M&A transactions, on either the buy-side or sell-side, is highly desirable. Additional business qualifications or professional train

jobs.title: VP / Head of E-commerce & Marketing – Paid Advisor
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Define and lead the overall e-commerce and digital marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and revenue targets. Oversee the performance of online sales channels, identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, conversion rates, retention, and average order value. Develop, implement, and optimize paid media strategies across relevant digital advertising platforms to maximize return on advertising spend (ROAS) and marketing investment. Lead customer acquisition and growth initiatives, using data-driven insights to improve campaign performance and commercial outcomes. Manage e-commerce operations and digital sales performance, ensuring a seamless customer journey across all online touchpoints. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including revenue, customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, lifetime value (LTV), and return on investment (ROI). Identify emerging market trends, customer behaviors, and new growth opportunities to strengthen the organization's competitive position. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, technology, and operations, to ensure effective execution of growth initiatives. Establish performance reporting frameworks and provide strategic recommendations to support data-driven decision-making. Build, mentor, and lead high-performing e-commerce and marketing teams, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Requirements Significant experience in senior leadership roles within e-commerce, digital marketing, growth marketing, or performance marketing. Proven track record of developing and executing successful e-commerce and paid acquisition strategies that deliver measurable business growth. Strong expertise in paid advertising platforms, campaign management, audience targeting, budget allocation, and performance optimization. Demonstrated ability to manage substantial marketing budgets while maximizing ROAS, improving CAC, and driving profitable customer acquisition. In-depth understanding of e-commerce platforms, digital sales funnels, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and customer lifecycle management. Strong analytical and strategic capabilities, with experience using marketing analytics, attribution tools, and performance dashboards to guide decisions. Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing stakeholders, and driving complex projects from strategy through execution. Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Commercially minded and highly results-oriented, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable growth strategies. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution. Strong understanding of emerging digital marketing trends, e-commerce technologies, and evolving customer acquisition strategies. Benefits Senior leadership opportunity: Take ownership of e-commerce and digital marketing strategy, with direct influence on business growth and commercial performance. Competitive compensation: Salary and overall package to be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated results. Strategic impact: Play a key role in shaping the organization's digital growth roadmap and long-term commercial direction. Professional development: Opportunity to expand leadership experience and contribute to innovative digital business initiatives. Collaborative environment: Work with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful results. Career growth: Opportunity to take on significant responsibilities within a strategic leadership position. Work flexibility: Employment location based in India; specific remote or hybrid arrangements to be confirmed.

jobs.title: Senior B2B Closer — Cloudspire
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Manage the complete B2B sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting potential customers to negotiating and closing new business. Generate your own leads and build a consistent pipeline of qualified US-based small and medium-sized business prospects. Conduct compelling product demonstrations and sales presentations, highlighting the value of VoIP phone systems, AI voice agents, and managed IT services. Engage directly with business owners and decision-makers, understand their operational challenges, and recommend tailored solutions. Handle objections, negotiate commercial terms, and confidently move prospects toward purchasing decisions. Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including pipeline activity, prospect interactions, follow-ups, and deal progress. Consistently work toward sales targets while demonstrating measurable results and strong ownership of individual performance. Requirements At least 3 years of proven full-cycle B2B sales experience, independently managing prospecting, demonstrations, negotiations, and deal closures. Demonstrated experience selling to US-based small and medium-sized businesses. Verifiable track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas, supported by commission statements or previous employer CRM and quota reports. Excellent spoken and written English, with near-native fluency and the confidence to communicate professionally with US business owners throughout the working day. Strong prospecting, negotiation, objection-handling, presentation, and closing skills. Excellent CRM management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage pipelines, follow-ups, and sales documentation. Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time. Ability to provide details of at least one independently closed B2B deal, including customer industry and size, deal value, sales cycle duration, and a former colleague or manager who can verify the results. Willingness to provide supporting sales performance documentation and two professional references (a former manager or customer) during the selection process. Previous experience in SaaS, VoIP, telecommunications, UCaaS, or managed IT services (MSP) is highly desirable. Benefits Competitive monthly base salary: Approximately $2,000–$3,000 USD gross, with compensation negotiable based on experience and demonstrated sales performance. Uncapped commission structure: Earn 100% of each new customer's first-month package price, excluding taxes, usage charges, overages, one-time fees, consulting, labor, and hardware. Performance-driven earning potential: Opportunity to significantly increase total compensation through successful deal closures. Fully remote position: Work from anywhere in the world. Full-time schedule: Monday through Friday, with consistent working hours aligned with US Eastern Time. Autonomy and ownership: Manage your own prospecting activities, sales pipeline, customer relationships, and closing strategy. Growth opportunity: Work in a technology-focused environment offering business communication, AI voice, and managed IT solutions to the US market. Application Process Applicants must complete the following steps in order: Record a 2-minute sales pitch: Before submitting written answers, record an audio or video pitch addressed to a US dental office owner who says, "We're happy with our current phones." Present the value of an AI-powered phone system using your own voice and words. AI-generated voices, scripts, or application responses are not accepted. Share a verifiable sales success story: Describe one B2B deal you personally closed, including the customer's industry and company size, deal value (monthly or annual), sales cycle duration, and a contact at your previous employer who can verify the transaction. Provide supporting evidence: Be prepared to share commission statements or CRM/quota reports demonstrating your sales performance, along with two professional refe

jobs.title: Freelance Linguist - EN > PT-BR | Technical / IT / Patent
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Translate documents and specialized content from English into Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR). Proofread, review, and refine translated materials to ensure accuracy, fluency, and consistency. Maintain terminology quality and apply appropriate language conventions across all assignments. Deliver high-quality work within agreed deadlines, including when working under tight time constraints. Collaborate with project managers and other team members to clarify requirements and support smooth project delivery. Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable project guidelines and professional standards. Requirements: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Brazilian Portuguese. Strong specialization and translation experience in at least one of the following fields: Technical, IT, or Patent. Excellent attention to detail, with strong spelling, grammar, and proofreading skills. Ability to manage workloads independently and deliver accurate work under tight deadlines. Candidates must meet at least one of the following minimum qualification criteria: A degree in Translation, Linguistics, Language Studies, or an equivalent qualification that includes significant translation training from a recognized higher education institution. At least 2 years of translation experience combined with a college degree. At least 5 years of translation experience without a college degree. A translation competence certificate issued by an appropriate government body. Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement. Availability to complete complimentary translation and machine translation post-editing (MTPE) tests as part of the evaluation process. An up-to-date CV highlighting relevant translation, MTPE, proofreading, and quality management (QM) experience. Ability to provide proposed best per-word rates in USD for translation, MTPE, and proofreading services. Benefits: Fully remote freelance opportunity, open to qualified candidates based in Brazil and other locations worldwide. Flexible freelance engagement supporting ongoing and upcoming projects. Opportunity to work on specialized translation assignments across technical, IT, and patent subject areas. Collaboration with project managers and other language professionals. Complimentary translation and MTPE assessments as part of the selection process. Opportunity to propose your own competitive per-word rates in USD for translation, MTPE, and proofreading services.

jobs.title: M&A and Corporate Transaction Senior Lawyer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Support cross-border M&A and corporate transactions across multiple geographies and jurisdictions, focusing on technology and gambling businesses. Conduct legal due diligence of targets across multiple jurisdictions. Structure transactions and market-entry projects, taking into account corporate, regulatory, tax, and financial considerations. Coordinate merger clearance, regulatory, and fiscal approvals with relevant authorities. Provide legal support throughout the transaction lifecycle, from initial structuring through closing and post-closing activities. Provide legal and regulatory support for entering and operating in regulated gambling markets, assessing requirements and restrictions for new markets, transactions, and corporate structures. Coordinate with gambling regulators and other authorities on licensing, approvals, and regulatory matters. jobs.title: Photoshop Graphic Design & Photo Production Virtual Assistant
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Process athlete images using the client’s established Photoshop workflow, placing predetermined poses into existing design templates. Properly size, center, and position athletes within each design, and adjust team names, colors, and other approved template elements. Prepare finished JPEG files for printing or digital delivery, maintaining consistent visual quality across large batches. Follow established sizing and print guidelines to prevent cropping or production errors. Work remotely alongside the on-site event team during sports competitions, processing images quickly enough to support live production. Communicate clearly about team completion and production status, and organize finished files so printing staff can access them quickly. Access and manage event files through the client’s Dropbox workflow, maintaining folder structures by event, team, division, pose, and finished product. Keep image files organized and correctly labeled, following established procedures for handling and protecting customer images. Prepare customer-approved designs for specialty products using existing templates, verifying names, jersey numbers, poses, colors, and other custom details. Communicate with the client about unclear customization requests and prepare approved designs for submission to third-party production vendors. Assist with weekday fulfillment work following weekend events. Review completed designs for alignment, sizing, proportions, spelling, and color accuracy before marking files complete, and flag anything that does not fit the standard workflow immediately. Requirements Adobe Photoshop experience, including background removal, templates, and image sizing. Strong attention to detail and speed. Availability on most weekends, with flexibility for weekday hours that may change (schedules shared about two weeks in advance). Availability for 20+ hours per week, with additional event-driven hours as needed. Willingness to sign an NDA and follow strict image privacy practices. Strong written and spoken English. Calm, dependable, and focused under event-day time pressure. Teachable and comfortable with repetitive, system-driven work. Comfort working with Dropbox and a client-provided team communication app (training provided on automated batch templates). Entry to junior level experience. Located in Saudi Arabia. Strongly preferred: High-volume photo editing experience (school, sports, or event photography). Preferred: Print sizing and production experience. Preferred: Batch processing or Photoshop automation experience. Nice to have: Custom product or merchandise design experience. Benefits Fully remote, part-time independent contractor engagement. Competitive rates with weekly payments. Free training and upskilling. Constant support and guidance. Access to a vibrant, supportive community of contractors. Access to various other open roles. Opportunity to grow with a business that plans to expand.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager – Gaming / iGaming Outsourcing
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Identify and generate new business opportunities through existing professional networks, direct outreach and industry connections. Manage the complete B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification to preparing proposals, negotiating commercial terms and closing contracts. Build, develop and maintain long-term relationships with game studios, publishers, iGaming operators and other potential clients. Identify client needs and business challenges, working closely with internal development and production teams to propose tailored outsourcing solutions. Lead commercial discussions, present service offerings, negotiate agreements and successfully convert opportunities into signed contracts. Develop, manage and continuously optimise a strong sales pipeline, ensuring consistent progress towards business development targets. Identify new markets, strategic accounts and potential partnership opportunities to support sustainable business growth. Leverage existing industry relationships while actively expanding the network of decision-makers and prospective clients. Represent the business at relevant industry conferences, networking events, client meetings and other commercial activities. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional experience in Business Development or B2B Sales within the gaming or iGaming industry. Previous experience selling outsourcing services, particularly game development, co-development or related production solutions, is highly desirable. An established professional network within the gaming or iGaming ecosystem, with access to relevant decision-makers and potential business partners. A proven track record of personally negotiating and closing commercial deals, rather than focusing exclusively on lead generation. Demonstrated ability to independently manage the entire sales cycle, from initial prospecting through to contract signing. Strong understanding of outsourcing business models and the commercial requirements of game studios, publishers or iGaming operators. Excellent negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to develop trust and maintain long-term client partnerships. A proactive, independent and commercially minded approach, with a strong focus on revenue generation and measurable results. Fluent English, both written and spoken. Russian language skills would be considered an advantage. Benefits: Fully remote work: Location flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere in the world. Competitive compensation: A base salary combined with a performance-based commission structure. Attractive earning potential: Long-term commission opportunities linked to successfully secured client contracts. Autonomy and ownership: Significant independence in managing your business development strategy, activities and commercial relationships. Business growth opportunities: The opportunity to leverage your existing professional network while exploring new markets and developing strategic partnerships. Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced game development, production and outsourcing professionals. Industry exposure: Build relationships with international clients and contribute to business growth across the gaming and iGaming sectors.

jobs.title: Storage Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead the architecture of the NVMe-oF storage platform, including evaluating and deciding between adopting existing software-defined storage and building on SPDK. Integrate networked block storage into a Kubernetes-based compute platform through CSI drivers and custom controllers, covering provisioning, attach/detach, resizing, and migration. Make Postgres fast on networked storage by profiling and tuning the full I/O path, from fsync, WAL, and checkpoints through the kernel block layer, NVMe/TCP, and the network. Design for durability and availability, including replication or erasure coding, failure domains, failover, and data-integrity verification. Build I/O isolation and QoS so that noisy neighbors cannot degrade other tenants. Set performance and reliability SLOs, and build the benchmarking and observability needed to hold the system to them. Design the layer for block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones, laying the groundwork for database branching. Keep the platform portable across AWS, other clouds, and bare-metal/colo environments. Write design docs, mentor engineers, and work closely with the Compute, Branching, Postgres, and Multicloud teams. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews. Resolve escalated support issues while identifying and fixing systemic issues across the platform. Requirements 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and operating storage systems in production. Experience building or operating distributed or software-defined block storage (for example Ceph RBD, Lightbits, Simplyblock, Portworx, LINSTOR/DRBD, or an in-house system). Hands-on experience with NVMe/TCP or NVMe-oF, including targets, initiators, multipath, and failover behavior. Deep understanding of Linux storage internals: the block layer, io_uring, page cache, O_DIRECT and fsync semantics, filesystems, and device-mapper. Strong systems programming skills in Go, plus C, C++, or Rust. Rigorous performance measurement using fio, pgbench, eBPF, and perf, with the ability to explain latency down to its individual components. Solid understanding of durability tradeoffs between replication, erasure coding, and consistency under failure. Experience leading technical direction on a complex system, including design docs, tradeoffs, and bringing others along. Experience with Kubernetes controllers and/or CSI drivers. Experience being on call for large production systems. Clear written communication and the ability to thrive in asynchronous, globally distributed teams. Located in India. Nice to have: SPDK development experience. Nice to have: RDMA/RoCE experience. Nice to have: Experience implementing block-level snapshots, thin provisioning, or copy-on-write cloning. Nice to have: Postgres internals knowledge (WAL, buffer manager, checkpointer), or familiarity with OrioleDB. Nice to have: Experience with AWS networking and instance storage at scale (ENA, placement, bandwidth limits). Nice to have: Experience running storage on bare metal or in colo. Nice to have: Contributions to open source storage projects or the Linux kernel storage stack. Benefits Fully remote work with no offices, plus a WeWork membership or co-working allowance usable anywhere in the world. Equity ownership (ESOP) for every team member. Tech allowance for laptop, monitor, headphones, or other home-office needs. Health insurance covered 100% for employees and 80% for dependents. Annual company off-site in a new city each year. Flexible, asynchronous work with trust to manage your own time. Annual education allowance for courses, books, conferences, or other learning. Open-source-first culture with a globally distributed team across 60+ countries.

jobs.title: Influencer & Media Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and execute PR and communications strategies for the publishing label and individual game releases, collaborating closely with the Social Media Manager to maximise visibility and commercial impact. Build, maintain and leverage relationships with games journalists, media outlets, influencers and content creators to secure reviews, features, coverage and promotional opportunities. Create compelling narratives around games, developers and upcoming releases, translating their unique selling points into engaging press releases, announcements and media pitches. Plan and coordinate PR initiatives and creator campaigns around key milestones, including game reveals, demos, Early Access launches and full releases. Establish, develop and actively manage player communities on Discord and Steam Community, driving engagement and fostering long-term relationships with players. Plan, host and deliver Steam livestreams to showcase games, engage audiences and support key promotional activities. Collaborate with developers and internal publishing, production and marketing teams to ensure consistent messaging, maximise exposure and address player feedback. Track media coverage, creator activity, community sentiment and campaign performance, using insights and data to continuously improve communication strategies and engagement. Requirements: Demonstrable experience in PR, influencer marketing, media relations or marketing communications, preferably within the PC and console gaming industry. An active and established network of games media contacts, journalists, influencers and content creators, with recent examples of successfully leveraging these relationships to secure coverage and promotional exposure. Hands-on experience planning, hosting and delivering Steam livestreams. Proven experience building, growing and actively managing gaming communities, particularly on Discord and Steam Community. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce engaging press releases, media pitches and promotional content. Strong understanding of the PC and console games market, independent game developers and gaming audiences. A proactive, commercially minded and hands-on approach, with the ability to manage multiple games and release campaigns in a growing publishing environment. Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, combined with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback. A performance-driven mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes, continuous improvement and experimentation. A curious, adaptable and solution-oriented attitude, with the confidence to take ownership, learn from mistakes and turn ideas into actionable results. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Salary based on qualifications, experience and suitability for the role. Equipment allowance: Financial support to purchase your own device or work equipment. Annual bonus: Opportunity to receive variable compensation through an annual bonus programme. Work from anywhere: Fully remote working, with the freedom to work from anywhere in the world. Flexible schedule: No fixed working hours, allowing you to organise your schedule around your responsibilities. Unlimited paid time off: Flexibility to take the time you need to recharge. International environment: Collaborate with a diverse, supportive and energetic team spread across six continents and more than 30 countries. Professional growth: An environment that encourages experimentation, continuous learning, ownership and career development. Direct impact: Freedom to contribute ideas, take initiative and present proposals directly to management. Global flexibility: Travel freely and receive compensation in your preferred currency.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (Internal Tools & Agents)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design, develop, maintain, and improve AI-powered internal tools that streamline workflows and support better business decisions. Build sophisticated Agent workflows incorporating context management, tool calling, knowledge retrieval, structured outputs, state management, and human approval or escalation processes. Integrate AI applications with internal data sources, APIs, business systems, and third-party services. Develop reliable and scalable backend services and APIs that support production AI applications. Work directly with internal stakeholders to understand operational processes, identify pain points, and define measurable success criteria. Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, testable, and deliverable technical solutions. Measure the impact of deployed tools through adoption, task-completion quality, time savings, error reduction, and other relevant performance indicators. Use production data, user feedback, and observed failures to prioritize improvements and continuously enhance solutions. Create evaluation datasets and regression tests for prompts, models, retrieval pipelines, tools, and end-to-end workflows. Establish release validation processes to detect quality regressions and unintended effects before deployment. Compare models and technical approaches based on output quality, latency, reliability, security, and cost. Implement robust handling of timeouts, retries, rate limits, asynchronous jobs, partial failures, and third-party dependency issues. Build and maintain logging, tracing, monitoring, versioning, and recovery mechanisms for AI workflows. Apply appropriate access controls, data-handling policies, human approval steps, and audit trails for sensitive internal processes. Troubleshoot issues across model behavior, prompts, knowledge sources, retrieval quality, tool responses, business rules, and backend infrastructure. Collaborate with AI engineers and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, and other functions to deliver effective solutions. Communicate technical feasibility, risks, costs, trade-offs, and alternative approaches clearly, while breaking larger initiatives into manageable delivery stages. Proactively communicate progress, blockers, timelines, and next steps, and document systems and technical decisions to support long-term maintainability. Requirements At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals. At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, Agent workflows, or AI automation systems. Demonstrated experience launching AI applications for real users and improving them using production data and user feedback. Practical experience with tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge retrieval, workflow orchestration, structured outputs, and stateful Agent systems. Experience developing production services, APIs, data pipelines, and integrations with internal or third-party systems. Strong hands-on proficiency in Golang. Golang is used for production development, and candidates must be able to complete the technical coding assessment in this language. Practical Python experience for LLM and AI application development. Experience creating evaluation datasets, regression tests, monitoring systems, and release validation processes for LLM applications. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across models, prompts, retrieval systems, tools, application logic, and backend infrastructure. Strong ownership and accountability, including the ability to identify risks early, follow through after launch, and verify that delivered solutions achieve their intended outcomes. Fluent spoken and written English, as it is the working language for daily communication and collaboration. Clear communication and collaboration skills, particularly in distributed and cross-functional teams. Nice to have: Experience developing internal productivity tools

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Co-maintain and progressively take technical ownership of an open-source PostgreSQL schema comparison and migration engine, reviewing contributions and eventually growing into its lead maintainer. Review, evaluate, and merge code contributions, including AI-generated pull requests, while ensuring high standards of correctness, maintainability, and security. Investigate and resolve reported issues related to schema differences, dependency ordering, migration generation, and PostgreSQL compatibility. Expand automated testing and validation coverage across multiple PostgreSQL versions to ensure consistent and reliable behavior. Ensure generated database migrations are safe, privilege-aware, and designed to prevent unintended data loss or security regressions. Identify potentially destructive schema changes and implement mechanisms to detect them and generate safer alternatives wherever possible. Contribute to the development of a stable 1.0 release, including defining public APIs, establishing semantic versioning contracts, improving documentation, and expanding PostgreSQL extension support. Engage with the open-source community by managing issue reports, reviewing external contributions, providing technical guidance, and maintaining constructive discussions with contributors. Collaborate with internal engineering teams to ensure consistent migration generation and execution across products, platform services, database branching, and AI-powered workflows. Write technical design documents, define architectural direction, and establish engineering strategies for the continued evolution of the tooling. Participate in the engineering team's on-call rotation, helping investigate and resolve production-related issues while supporting reliable software delivery. Requirements: At least 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including extensive hands-on experience with PostgreSQL. Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, particularly system catalogs such as pg_catalog and pg_depend , object ownership, permissions, grants, default privileges, Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, and extension membership. Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL DDL operations and database migration semantics, including locking behavior, transactional limitations, dependency management, and the identification of potentially destructive changes. A security-conscious engineering mindset, with particular attention to preventing unauthorized privilege changes, accidental access exposure, and unintended data loss. Strong proficiency in TypeScript and the ability to develop reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software. Experience designing advanced testing strategies for correctness, including differential testing, property-based testing, and test corpus validation across multiple PostgreSQL versions. Familiarity with compiler-style engineering challenges, including dependency graphs, topological sorting, cycle detection, and schema comparison algorithms. Ability to review and understand complex code changes within sophisticated codebases, including contributions generated with AI-assisted development tools. Proven experience owning and maintaining production software, including staged releases, error monitoring, incident investigation, and responding to real-world user feedback. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, from initial problem definition and architectural planning through production implementation. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to document technical decisions clearly. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and collaborate successfully within asynchronous, globally distributed engineering teams. Nice to Have: Previous experience developing or maintaining database schema comparison and migration tools such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, Flyway, or Liquibase. Familiarity with PostgreSQL backup and sc
