jobs.title: Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist based in India. We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist to manage and optimize the billing, invoicing, and collections processes for growing U.S.-based businesses. In this role, you will take ownership of the accounts receivable cycle, ensuring accurate financial records, timely payments, and effective cash flow management. You will work closely with accounting, sales, customers, and leadership teams to resolve discrepancies and improve collection performance. Your analytical skills and proactive approach will help identify payment delays, strengthen financial processes, and maintain reliable reporting. This fully remote opportunity offers exposure to international business operations and direct collaboration with decision-makers. It is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who values accuracy, accountability, and continuous process improvement. Accountabilities:: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices and quotations, ensuring compliance with contractual agreements and purchase orders. Verify invoice details against customer orders, contracts, and supporting documentation, identifying and correcting discrepancies when necessary. Monitor outstanding accounts receivable balances and proactively follow up with customers to secure overdue payments. Manage collections activities professionally and consistently, maintaining positive customer relationships while ensuring timely payment. Respond to customer inquiries regarding invoices, payment terms, billing discrepancies, and account balances with clarity and professionalism. Record and reconcile incoming payments against outstanding invoices, investigating and resolving payment discrepancies. Identify the root causes of delayed payments and develop practical solutions to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding balances. Prepare regular accounts receivable, collections, and revenue reports to provide leadership with accurate financial insights. Maintain data consistency across accounting platforms and other business systems, ensuring accurate and up-to-date financial records. Identify opportunities to improve billing and collections workflows through better tools, automation, and standardized procedures. Collaborate with accounting, sales, and management teams to strengthen financial coordination and optimize the overall payment cycle. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in accounts receivable, billing, collections, or a related accounting and finance position. Practical experience using QuickBooks or comparable accounting and financial management software. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with the ability to manage financial data, reconciliations, and reporting. Solid understanding of accounts receivable processes, invoicing, payment allocation, collections, and account reconciliation. Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies, and maintain accurate financial records. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when investigating delayed payments and resolving complex billing issues. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain financial and billing matters clearly to customers and non-finance stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to manage payment follow-ups professionally, confidently, and diplomatically. Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, identify potential issues, and communicate challenges proactively. Experience working with multiple accounting platforms or payment systems is considered an advantage. Availability to work in alignment with U.S. Eastern business hours. A suitable

These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. This role works closely with Quality, Program Squads, Talent, vendors and other stakeholders to provide precise language support for patent-related matters. Minimum of BA/BS degree or equivalent experience A good understanding of Machine Translation (MT) Native-level fluency in German language and English fluent. Knowledge of European Patent Convention patent law. Familiarity with diverse CAT tools and QA tools,e.g. XTM, SDL Studio, and issue tracking and query management tools, e.g. JIRA. Good user experience of standard software, such as Windows and Office applications. Knowledge of the language services industry and a keen interest in its technology, process, competitive landscape, and emerging trends. Requirements: Professional experience: At least 4 years of experience in manual quality assurance or software testing, primarily involving web applications or backend systems. Testing fundamentals: Strong understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality assurance methodologies. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Accounting Manager, you will oversee the complete accounting function, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and compliance with relevant accounting standards. You will work closely with leadership and accounting support teams to maintain reliable financial records and improve financial processes. Manage the full accounting cycle, including account reconciliations, month-end closing, and year-end closing. Prepare and deliver accurate monthly financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense management, and vendor payments. Identify billing discrepancies, unusual transactions, and potential financial errors to protect business resources. Integrate external tools and applications with accounting systems such as QuickBooks Online to streamline workflows. Prepare accurate and organized financial records for annual reviews and external CPA firms. Support leadership with budgeting, financial forecasting, and cash flow planning. Develop and strengthen internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures as the business grows. Supervise and support bookkeepers or accounting staff, providing guidance and constructive feedback. Use digital collaboration and accounting tools, including QuickBooks Online, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Bill.com, Gusto, Ramp, and ClickUp. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced accounting professional with a strong understanding of U.S. accounting practices, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to independently manage financial operations. You should be comfortable working in a remote environment, communicating financial information clearly, and taking ownership of accounting processes. At least 5 years of accounting experience working with U.S.-based companies, including full-cycle accounting responsibilities. Strong knowledge of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP). Advanced experience with QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting platform, including integrating third-party applications. CPA certification or a local accounting qualification, such as Contador Público, is an advantage. Previous experience collaborating with external CPA firms or supporting multiple clients is a plus. Experience supervising, mentoring, or guiding accounting professionals, even without a formal management title. Strong financial judgment and the ability to navigate fast-paced business environments. Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to provide clear updates to remote teams. High levels of ownership, integrity, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Must be based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe. Benefits: Competitive salary in USD, paid consistently on a monthly basis and determined by experience. 10 paid vacation days per year. All U.S. national holidays observed. 100% remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe. Opportunity to work directly with business leaders and contribute to important financial decisions. Collaborative, supportive, and high-trust working environment. Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own the design and implementation of key website experiences, balancing creative excellence with technical quality and business objectives. Your responsibilities will include: Lead the design and development of core website experiences, including the homepage, product pages, pricing pages, and navigation, from initial exploration through responsive implementation and launch. Translate complex technical product concepts into clear visual explanations, engaging interfaces, and interactive demonstrations that help users understand and evaluate the platform. Refine typography, visual hierarchy, composition, motion, and interaction details to create a distinctive and consistent experience across devices. Build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, and page patterns that connect the visual design system with production code. Develop accessible, mobile-friendly, high-performance website experiences that follow modern web standards and work consistently across browsers. Collaborate with Design, Marketing, Growth, and engineering partners on product launches, website experiments, and conversion-focused initiatives. Take projects through design reviews, testing, release, and ongoing optimization, using user feedback and website performance data to improve usability and conversion. Share ideas proactively, develop prototypes, and make thoughtful decisions that balance creative ambition, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines. Explore and implement AI-powered workflows, including machine-readable design specifications, reusable skills, and internal tools that accelerate creative and development processes. Help evolve the website's design system and identify opportunities to improve collaboration, consistency, and production efficiency. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines exceptional visual design judgment with strong frontend engineering capabilities and a proven ability to deliver polished digital experiences independently. You should be comfortable moving between design tools and code, experimenting with new technologies, and collaborating with distributed teams. Key qualifications include: 6–10 years of relevant experience designing and building websites or interactive digital experiences. A track record of owning projects end to end as a hands-on individual contributor. An active portfolio website, GitHub profile, or relevant social profile showcasing high-quality websites and interactive experiences, with a clear indication of your personal contributions. Strong visual and interaction design fundamentals, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and responsive layouts. Advanced proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Experience building production websites with React and modern web frameworks such as Astro. Hands-on experience with canvas animations and shaders, and the ability to prototype motion and interactions directly in the browser. Proficiency in Figma and experience exploring design concepts through both visual tools and code. Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools and the ability to use AI-first workflows to accelerate design exploration and implementation. Practical knowledge of web performance, accessibility standards, and browser behavior, including the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues. Ability to translate open-ended briefs into finished digital experiences, explain design and technical decisions, and incorporate feedback from different disciplines. Strong initiative, independent problem-solving skills, and clear communication in a fully distributed team. Proficiency with macOS and comfort collaborating remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom. Additional experience that would be advantageous: Experience with three.js, WebGL, motion.dev, Blender, or other 3D and animation technologies. Background working on technical B2B products. Experience with Astro and interactive data visualization. Benefits: Ann

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and execute multi-channel lead-generation strategies that attract qualified prospects, improve conversion rates, and support business growth. Own and optimize the complete lead-generation funnel, from traffic acquisition and lead capture through Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), and sales opportunities. Maintain accountability for lead quality, pipeline contribution, and the overall effectiveness of marketing initiatives. Manage marketing projects end to end, including market research, strategic planning, campaign development, execution, testing, performance analysis, and continuous optimization. Plan and implement organic-first, multi-channel growth programs, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, design, and development specialists to achieve campaign objectives. Identify new growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, audience insights, and marketing performance data. Monitor and report on the entire lead-generation funnel, analyzing traffic acquisition, landing-page engagement, lead capture, nurturing, qualification, and conversion. Plan and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives to improve user experience, increase conversions, and strengthen lead-generation performance. Continuously optimize website performance, organic search visibility, user experience, and conversion rates, implementing improvements independently or in collaboration with specialists. Support outbound marketing and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives in partnership with Sales and Business Development teams. Work closely with Sales to understand lead quality, customer needs, and market feedback, using these insights to refine audience targeting, messaging, and campaign effectiveness. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation, with a demonstrated track record of generating qualified leads and improving marketing performance. Experience in B2B software development, IT services, SaaS, or the technology sector, preferably involving complex buying journeys and longer sales cycles. At least 2 years of experience owning marketing campaigns or cross-functional initiatives from strategic planning through execution and performance evaluation. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing, including content, email, social media, PPC, and CRO. Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AEO, including keyword research, search intent, and strategies for improving organic visibility. Strong analytical capabilities and hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or comparable analytics and reporting tools. Ability to connect marketing activities and performance metrics to qualified leads, sales pipeline, and revenue outcomes. Strong proficiency with AI tools and practical experience using them to improve research, content creation, data analysis, and campaign workflows. Solid understanding of audience segmentation, targeting, positioning, and messaging, with the ability to develop compelling value propositions for different customer groups. Proactive, ownership-driven mindset, with a willingness to experiment, prioritize initiatives based on potential impact, and move projects forward independently. Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, guide specialists, and provide constructive feedback. Fluent English proficiency at C1 level or higher. Nice-to-have qualifications: Experience with marketing automation tools, CRM platforms, email nurturing sequences, and lead qualification processes. Advanced knowledge of conversion rate optimization, landing-page experimentation, and user behavior analysis. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the freedom to work from anywhere with a stable internet connection. Flexible working hours and the ability to choose a preferred time zone and work schedule. Competitive, negotiable hourly

jobs.title: Showrunner - Storyby
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take full creative ownership of individual film projects, ensuring quality and consistency throughout the entire production lifecycle. Develop concepts and stories for vertical series, from initial ideas and synopses to episode outlines and finalized scripts. Build compelling season narratives, including character and romantic arcs, conflicts, emotional turning points, engaging hooks, and cliffhangers. Review, edit, and provide constructive feedback on scripts, ensuring they meet creative and storytelling expectations. Oversee editing and post-production, reviewing cuts and providing direction on pacing, narrative structure, music, sound, emotional impact, and overall storytelling. Conduct final creative quality checks to ensure each finished film aligns with its original vision and content standards. Collaborate closely with screenwriters, producers, editors, and other creative professionals throughout production. Research vertical dramas, short-form entertainment, and emerging market trends, translating insights into innovative content strategies. Analyze audience feedback and post-release performance metrics to identify opportunities and apply learnings to future productions. Leverage AI-powered tools to support content development, creative iteration, and production workflows. Requirements: Hands-on experience writing or developing scripts for films, television series, digital entertainment, or short-form content. Strong understanding of dramatic storytelling and serialized narratives, including character development, pacing, conflict, hooks, and cliffhangers. Knowledge of editing and post-production processes, with an understanding of how scene structure, music, sound, and editing choices influence audience engagement. Ability to oversee a production holistically, from initial script development to final editing, making creative decisions that strengthen the finished story. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the overall creative outcome of each production. Understanding of mobile-first audiences and the specific storytelling techniques that distinguish vertical series from traditional films and television. Ability to manage multiple creative iterations efficiently and give and receive constructive feedback. Excellent creative judgment, independent decision-making, and problem-solving skills. English proficiency at B2 level or above. Nice to have: Experience working on vertical dramas or microdramas. Previous collaboration with video editors and post-production teams. Experience in performance marketing or working closely with performance teams, with an understanding of how creative concepts, hooks, and storytelling influence audience attention and conversion. Familiarity with content formats and trends on platforms such as ReelShort, DramaBox, and ShortMax. Experience using AI tools for text, image, or video generation. Understanding of content performance metrics, including retention and completion rates. Experience working across screenwriting, production management, and creative development. Benefits: End-to-end creative ownership: Take responsibility for each production from the first creative concept through to the final release, with the opportunity to shape its story, characters, script, editing, and overall performance. Meaningful creative impact: Directly influence the quality, direction, and success of digital entertainment products designed to engage global audiences. Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced professionals, creative specialists, producers, and business leaders, with opportunities to exchange knowledge and expertise. Professional development: Access specialized learning programs, management training, AI-focused workshops, and professional communities to continuously develop your skills. Knowledge-sharing culture: Benefit from a strong professional network and access to expertise across multiple business functions. Social impact opportunities: Particip

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst based in India. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming financial data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions. You will work closely with accounting, operations, and leadership teams at growing U.S.-based businesses, providing accurate reporting, financial forecasts, and performance analysis. Your responsibilities will span financial modeling, budgeting, KPI tracking, and process improvement. You will help identify financial trends, uncover discrepancies, monitor costs, and improve reporting accuracy. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on business performance while working in a fully remote, collaborative environment. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating complex financial information clearly to stakeholders. Accountabilities:: Develop and maintain financial models and forecasts to support strategic planning and informed business decisions. Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop dashboards that provide clear visibility into business performance. Support budgeting processes, expense planning, and financial projections. Analyze actual financial results against budgets and forecasts, investigate significant variances, identify underlying causes, and communicate actionable recommendations. Reconcile financial data across accounting systems and other business tools, identifying inconsistencies and resolving errors proactively. Monitor cost increases, declining profit margins, and unusual financial transactions to identify potential risks and improvement opportunities. Establish and maintain data standards and reporting practices to ensure financial records remain accurate and consistent as the business grows. Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and reports to address leadership requests and support operational decisions. Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting tools, workflows, and processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and reliability. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), accounting, or business operations. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and structured financial modeling. Practical knowledge of QuickBooks or comparable accounting software. Experience using financial dashboards, reporting platforms, and data visualization tools. Strong analytical abilities and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify meaningful discrepancies and financial trends. Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders without a finance background. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the confidence to raise concerns and recommend improvements. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with accounting, operations, and leadership teams. Availability to work in alignment with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Must be based in India. Nice to have: SQL knowledge or experience working with financial data through database queries. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Salary paid in USD on a consistent monthly basis, with the amount determined by experience and qualifications. Fully remote work: 100% remote working arrangement with the flexibility to work from a professional home setup. Paid time off: 10 paid vacation days per year. Public holidays: All U.S. national holidays observed. Direct leadership exposure: Work closely with business leaders and contribute directly to financial reporting and strategic decision-making. jobs.title: Assurance Climate Risk Consultant
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and refine climate risk indicators and comprehensive frameworks covering both physical and transition risks. Design indicators using the IPCC AR6 hazard, exposure, and vulnerability framework, including thresholds, normalization methods, scoring and classification logic, and aggregation from grid cells to assets, basins, and portfolios. Support the development of climate scenario analysis solutions aligned with IFRS S2 and ESRS methodologies, including selecting, processing, and validating climate projection datasets across emissions scenarios, time horizons, and baseline periods. Prepare detailed indicator specifications, data dictionaries, and methodology documentation that Product and Engineering teams can implement and that provide sufficient auditability for client disclosures. Assess the financial implications of climate scenarios, including cost modeling and financial impact assessments across sectors such as manufacturing, technology, and textiles. Contribute to the development of climate resilience and adaptation opportunity libraries linked to identified potential risks. Validate climate indicators against observed data and published benchmarks, conduct sensitivity analyses, and establish methods for communicating uncertainty and confidence to platform users. Support climate-related disclosure preparation in accordance with CSRD/ESRS and IFRS S2, including identifying and mapping relevant data points, metrics, and reporting requirements. Lead and support CSRD limited-assurance readiness activities by establishing evidence trails, controls, and documentation capable of withstanding external assurance reviews. Monitor and interpret evolving CSRD/ESRS and IFRS regulatory guidance, identifying changes that may affect ongoing projects and internal methodologies. Collaborate with the Professional Services team to translate technical climate and disclosure requirements into practical internal frameworks, methodologies, and deliverables. Contribute to CSRD requirements gap analyses and define the work needed for preliminary disclosures, dry runs, and first-time reporting exercises. Ensure consistency and alignment between climate risk methodologies and existing water risk indicators. Deliver internal training and knowledge-sharing sessions to strengthen the broader team's understanding of climate risk and disclosure requirements. Requirements: Mandatory assurance experience: Hands-on experience in sustainability or climate assurance at a Big Four firm, ideally within a Climate Change and Sustainability Services practice, including CSRD/ESRS or climate-related assurance engagements. Candidates must understand the evidence, controls, and documentation required to successfully support a limited-assurance review. This is a non-negotiable requirement. Bachelor's degree in Climate Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related discipline. A Master's degree or PhD in Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Geosciences, or a related field is also expected. At least 7 years of senior-level experience in climate risk and resilience assessment, corporate sustainability, climate disclosure consulting, or sustainability assurance. Demonstrated experience leading or owning climate risk, sustainability reporting, or CSRD-related engagements from beginning to end. Strong working knowledge of climate-related financial disclosure frameworks, particularly IFRS S2, together with familiarity with CSRD and ESRS requirements. Experience working with physical and transition climate risk scenarios and datasets, including NGFS scenarios, IEA pathways, carbon price trajectories, and sector decarbonization pathways such as SBTi and TPI. Understanding of how climate scenarios translate into financial impacts, including the ability to assess potential costs and business exposure. Experience integrating climate risk considerations into enterprise risk management systems and corporate disclosure frameworks.

Work with security, infrastructure, and central engineering teams to apply shared standards and ensure consistency across applications. Lead a small team of Full-stack Developers, overseeing work allocation, delivery priorities, team performance, and professional development. Support applications with different technical foundations, adapting to unfamiliar languages and codebases while maintaining consistent engineering and operational practices. Previous experience managing or leading a small software engineering team, including work distribution and performance management. Proficiency in at least two of the following technologies: Python, TypeScript, and Node.js, with the ability to become productive quickly in unfamiliar codebases. Hands-on experience with Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines, including tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins. Experience introducing observability practices and automated regression testing into applications that were not originally built with these capabilities. Practical knowledge of application security, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and dependency vulnerability checks. Production experience with MySQL. Strong proficiency with AI-assisted coding tools and the technical judgment to review, validate, and harden AI-generated code. Technical environment: Languages and frameworks: Python, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Java. Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, MySQL. Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry. Benefits: Remote-first working environment. Competitive salary with individual performanc

jobs.title: Travel Advisor
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Plan, coordinate, and book personalized travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, vacation packages, and other travel-related services. Develop customized travel itineraries based on clients' preferences, interests, budgets, schedules, and desired experiences. Research destinations, travel options, accommodation providers, and activities to provide relevant recommendations and help clients make informed decisions. Manage client inquiries and communications professionally, providing timely assistance, answering questions, and supporting travelers throughout the booking process. Handle reservations, maintain accurate client records, and ensure appropriate follow-ups to deliver a smooth and organized customer experience. Monitor travel industry trends, seasonal promotions, destination updates, and available offers to provide clients with competitive and relevant travel options. Build positive client relationships through personalized recommendations, attentive service, and consistent communication. Use the provided business tools and personal website to manage travel-related activities and develop your professional presence. Continuously develop your knowledge of destinations, travel products, booking processes, and industry opportunities to improve service quality and client satisfaction. Requirements: Must be at least 18 years old. Must reside in an eligible country where the partner is authorized to operate. Please note that India is not included in the eligible countries listed in the original job posting, so applicants based in India should confirm their eligibility with the hiring partner before proceeding. No previous travel industry experience is required; motivated beginners and individuals looking to transition into the travel sector are encouraged to apply. Genuine passion for travel, tourism, discovering new destinations, and helping others create memorable travel experiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with clients. Customer-focused mindset and a genuine commitment to delivering personalized service and positive client experiences. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing reservations, travel itineraries, and client information. Ability to understand client needs, recommend suitable travel options, and customize experiences within established budgets. Basic budgeting and financial management skills, with the ability to compare travel options and identify solutions that align with client expectations. Self-motivation, adaptability, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Willingness to learn new booking tools, industry platforms, and travel-related systems while staying informed about market developments. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, allowing you to work from home. Flexible schedule, providing greater autonomy over your working hours. Access to travel discounts and exclusive industry incentives. Dedicated personal website to support your travel advisory activities and professional presence. Business tools and resources provided to help manage your travel-related activities. Liability insurance included. Access to familiarization (FAM) travel opportunities to discover destinations and gain firsthand industry knowledge. Professional certifications and learning opportunities to support your development in the travel industry. Opportunity to build a career in travel planning without requiring previous professional experience. Potential to develop valuable customer service, travel consulting, and business management skills.

jobs.description: Job Title: Vehicle Inspection Specialist Employment Type: Full-time, On-site Location: Soum Car Showroom, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Operations Language Requirement: Fluent in Arabic Role Overview Every car Soum hands over carries our name, so its condition has to be exactly what we promised. The Vehicle Inspection Specialist owns the technical truth about each vehicle: you inspect it when it first comes in, identify and document any damage or defects, carry out the final inspection before handover, and assess technical issues raised after the sale. You also support the Cars Operations team with day-to-day operational tasks. This is a technical role, not a customer-facing one. The After-Sales Customer Experience Specialist owns all customer communication, complaints, and follow-ups. You give them accurate, clearly documented findings so they can keep the customer informed and resolve the case. The goal of the role: no car leaves the showroom with an undocumented defect, every inspection report is accurate and complete, and technical issues are diagnosed quickly and routed to the right fix. Duties & Responsibilities: Vehicle Handover Schedule handover appointments with customers and confirm the time, location, and documents they need to bring. Before each appointment, confirm that the car has passed its pre-handover check and that all accessories are present: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Walk the customer through the car's condition and inspection report, and introduce its key features. Sign the handover form with the customer and document it with photos. Vehicle Inspection & Condition Assessment Conduct the initial inspection of every vehicle, covering the body, exterior, interior, and overall condition, against Soum's approved inspection checklist. Assess mechanical and electrical components, including the engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, steering, and electrical systems. Identify and report any damage, defects, previous repairs, issues, or discrepancies against what was listed or agreed with the buyer. Assess the overall condition of each vehicle and record it consistently, so that condition ratings mean the same thing across every car. Inspection Reports & Documentation Produce a clear, accurate inspection report for every vehicle inspected, written so that a non-technical colleague can explain it to a customer. Take photographs of each vehicle's condition and of every defect found, and attach them to the report. Record all findings, reports, and photos in the system so they are available to Sales and After-Sales. Keep inspection records complete and up to date, so the condition of any vehicle at any stage can be verified. Pre-Handover Checks Conduct the final inspection before vehicle handover or completion, confirming the car matches its inspection report and has not changed in condition since it was listed. Verify that every car is complete with all accessories: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Confirm that the car is ready, or flag what must be fixed before the handover appointment. Post-Sale Technical Issues & Escalation Assess technical issues raised in post-sale warranty requests and complaints, using the case details passed on by the After-Sales CX Specialist. Determine the likely cause, whether the issue was present at handover, and the recommended fix. Document your technical findings in the case so the After-Sales CX Specialist can update the customer. Escalate technical issues outside your authority in line with approved procedures. Workshops & Cars Operations Brief approved maintenance workshops on the technical findings and the work required. Review completed repairs and confirm the issue has been fixed before the case is closed. Feed recurring defects and post-sale technical complaints back into the inspection checklist to improve future inspections. Coordinate with the Operations team throughout the car journey, from initial inspection to handover. Support other Cars Operations tasks when requir

jobs.title: Senior Crude Oil Analyst
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Crude Oil Research Analyst based in Dubai, you will serve as Kpler’s regional market authority on Middle Eastern physical crude dynamics, focusing on refinery activity, product yields, and downstream trade flows. Operating at the crossroads of physical cargo tracking and fundamental market analysis, you will translate complex refinery runs and crude movements into clear, actionable intelligence. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your insights will directly empower global commodity traders and market participants to navigate physical trading, arbitrage, and downstream market shifts with confidence. Key Responsibilities:: Deliver in-depth market intelligence: Conduct rigorous research on Middle Eastern physical crude and refined product markets, focusing on refinery runs, crude throughput, planned maintenance, and physical trade flows . Advance supply, demand, and refinery modeling: Maintain and refine proprietary supply-demand and refinery activity models, ensuring high data integrity compared against international benchmarks such as JODI, EIA, and IEA . Strengthen OSP advisory capabilities: Spearhead analysis and client-facing insights around Middle Eastern Official Selling Prices (OSPs), pricing mechanisms, and crude grade differentials . Publish timely market commentary: Author high-quality research reports, concise market briefs, and ad-hoc commentary highlighting Kpler’s proprietary cargo and inventory data for global clients . Represent Kpler across the industry: Present regional market insights during client briefings, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements to expand Kpler’s thought leadership across the Middle East . Drive commercial and product innovation: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Engineering teams to support pre-sales discussions, demonstrate data value, and co-develop next-generation analytics offerings . Experience & Background:: 5+ years of prior professional experience analysing crude oil markets, with deep familiarity with refinery operations, trading dynamics, and physical trade flows . Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or Energy Management) . Proven track record of independently researching, analysing, and writing clear, data-driven market commentary and insights . Strong data analytics and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience manipulating complex datasets to assess supply, demand, and refinery margins . Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to convey technical market context to clients, media, and cross-functional teams . Nice-to-haves: Practical experience using Kpler cargo-tracking data, AIS platforms, or similar energy intelligence tools . Working familiarity with data querying and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or R . Direct familiarity with Middle Eastern crude pricing benchmarks, national oil company (NOC) pricing structures, and regional refinery configurations .

jobs.title: AI Voice Recording Contributor - Arabic (Gulf)
jobs.region: Doha / Al Khor / Al Rayyan / Al Wakrah / Dukhan / Lusail / Madinat ash Shamal / Umm Salal
jobs.description: We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join an Arabic (Gulf) voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies. Job Type: Freelance Location: Work from home Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day) Project Duration: Approximately 1 month Start Date: Immediately Rate: 6 USD/hour Help Shape the Future of AI This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect. You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents. How Your Recordings Will Be Used Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems. What You’ll Do: Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person). Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided. Speak using your natural dialect and accent. Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered. Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards. Complete tasks using our internal recording platform. What We’re Looking For: Native-level fluency in Arabic (Gulf). Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use. Advanced level of English to understand written instructions. Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent. Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own. Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required. Strong communication skills and attention to detail. Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy. Technical Requirements: Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise. Computer microphone or headset with microphone. Reliable internet connection. Ability to access and use an online recording platform. What We Offer: Flexible, remote work. Timely and reliable payments. Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology. Access to future language and AI-related projects. A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

jobs.title: Consumer Product Manager
jobs.description: About Soum Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom. About the Role The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform. You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship. Key Responsibilities: Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust. Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data. Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing. Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics. Translate problems into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with design and engineering, from discovery through release and iteration. Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localisation for Saudi customers. Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS and customer complaints. Partner cross-functionally with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to make sure product changes work end to end, not just on screen. Keep a close eye on regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players, and bring the best ideas back to Soum, adapted for our customers. Requirements: 2–4 years of product management experience on consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech or consumer apps. A proven track record of shipping consumer features that moved measurable business metrics, and the ability to explain exactly how. Strong consumer intuition backed by data: comfortable with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis and A/B testing; working SQL is a strong plus. Hands-on experience building for mobile (iOS and Android) and web. Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust and pricing. Experience working closely with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specs and sharp prioritisation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to align operations, commercial and tech teams around a decision. A true owner who moves fast, takes decisions with incomplete information and cares more about outcomes than output.

Demonstrated negotiation skills with experience managing contract cycles and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Customer Success, Sales Operations, Marketing). Strong self-motivation, high accountability, and the resilience to excel within a fast-paced, dynamic growth environment.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President – Data Science
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE As an AVP– Data Science, you will design, build, and productionize advanced analytics and AI solutions that drive measurable business value. You will work closely with Data Product Owners, Data Analysts, BI Developers, and Data Quality Specialists to translate complex business challenges into data-driven models and experiments. Leveraging Python, SQL, and modern ML frameworks, you will develop scalable machine learning solutions that are explainable, governed, and aligned with organizational priorities. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Translate business problems into data science projects by defining clear hypotheses, success metrics, and validation methods. Explore, clean, and transform structured and unstructured data using Python and SQL to prepare high-quality datasets for modeling. Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models using appropriate algorithms and statistical techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, NLP, forecasting). Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to productionize AI models through reproducible pipelines and CI/CD workflows. Apply model explainability, fairness, and interpretability techniques (e.g., SHAP, LIME, feature importance) to ensure transparency and accountability. Support AI governance activities, including Model Risk Management (MRM) processes, ensuring compliance and responsible use of AI. Conduct and analyze A/B tests or controlled experiments to assess model and feature performance. Work with Data Product Owners to define business outcomes, monitor model performance post-deployment, and ensure continued relevance. Collaborate with Data Quality Specialists to ensure input data meets quality, lineage, and governance standards. Communicate results effectively through visualizations, storytelling, and presentations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences. RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 6+ years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, or advanced analytics. Proven experience delivering models that have been deployed and integrated into business processes or digital products. Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM). Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and validation. Experience working in Databricks or equivalent data and ML platforms. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and ML lifecycle tools (MLflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of model explainability, ethics, fairness, and governance. Knowledge of AI governance processes and documentation standards, including Model Risk Management (MRM). Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, Snowflake) and APIs for integrating AI models into applications. Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub) and collaborative coding practices. Excellent communication skills to explain technical findings in clear business terms. Collaborative and curious, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation QUALIFICATION Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master’s degree or higher in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied Statistics is an advantage.

The VP – Commercials ensures disciplined investment decisions, scalable commercial frameworks, and measurable value creation for Aldar, partners, and members. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Responsibilities Define and lead the commercial strategy for Darna's loyalty products and propositions, ensuring clear value creation for Aldar, partners, and members. Establish scalable pricing, funding, and monetization models that balance member attractiveness with financial sustainability. Translate programme growth ambitions into clear commercial targets, revenue streams, and contribution margin frameworks.
